items.description: One 8 KB skill that replaces REA (Reverse Engineer Anything): plain CLI tools, no MCP. Benchmarked: 38% faster, 35% cheaper.
items.readme:
# leanrea

**One 8 KB skill file that does what [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) does: no MCP server, no 207 tools, no setup.**

REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) puts an MCP layer between your agent and tools it can already use: asar, otool, nm, `go version -m`, jadx, apktool, Ghidra, tshark, binwalk, sqlite3. leanrea drops that layer. It tells the agent which command is fastest for each kind of target, gives it ready-to-paste recon commands, and lists the traps that REA's code handles for you. The agent then runs the real tools itself.

|  | REA 6.5.0 | leanrea |
|---|---|---|
| What gets installed | 25 MB npm package + MCP server | one `SKILL.md` |
| Instructions | 23.5 KB skill + 48.8 KB references | 8 KB |
| Tools added to the agent | 207 (3.35 MB of definitions) | 0 (uses Bash) |
| Context for "Reply OK", all tools loaded | 400.7k tokens, $1.60 | 34.5k tokens, $0.09 |

## Benchmark

Claude Code headless (`claude -p`), Sonnet 5.5, macOS arm64. 4 reverse-engineering tasks × 3 reps × 3 arms, with the arms run side by side. Answers are graded against hand-made keys.

| arm | total wall time | cost | turns | tokens | score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **leanrea** | **388 s** | **$2.17** | **55** | **2.40 M** | 74/75 |
| no skill | 479 s | $2.21 | 81 | 3.11 M | 67/75 (one refusal) |
| REA (MCP + its skill) | 627 s | $3.36 | 124 | 5.93 M | 75/75 |

Against REA, leanrea had **38% less wall time, 35% lower cost, 56% fewer turns and 60% fewer tokens, at the same accuracy**. Its one partial miss named an older IPC channel instead of the v2 one (both channels exist).

The tasks:
- **electron**: trace a feature through a real Electron app's app.asar (native function → main-process class → IPC channels).
- **native**: inventory the exports, a TCC permission check and the single-instance lock of that app's native addon (`.node`).
- **go**: toolchain and dependency versions of a stripped `gh` binary.
- **deep**: from disassembly alone, the exact socket path format, wire protocol and peer authentication of that lock.

The same operation run through REA's CLI vs the raw command:

| operation | REA | raw |
|---|---|---|
| Go build info | 0.56 s | `go version -m`: 0.06 s |
| Mach-O overview | 3.32 s | otool + dyld_info + nm: 0.04 s |
| Electron app analysis (real desktop app) | fails on asar integrity until you pass a flag, then **47.9 s and 140 MB of JSON** | asar extract + `rg -uu`: 4.8 s, 24 KB |

Full tables, the context-overhead runs and caveats: [bench/BENCHMARK.md](bench/BENCHMARK.md). Raw per-run metrics: [bench/results/final.jsonl](bench/results/final.jsonl).

**Caveats:**
- Only 3 reps per cell, one model, one machine.
- REA was tested in its best case: Claude Code's deferred tool search loads MCP tools on demand. Agents that load every tool pay the 400k-token row.
- Ghidra, Hopper and jadx weren't installed, so the native tasks ran on Xcode tools for both arms.
- The plain model is already good at this. leanrea's gain over no skill (about 19% faster, 32% fewer turns) is smaller than its gain over REA.

## Install

```sh
npx skills add aicodeking/leanrea
```

This uses the [skills CLI](https://skills.sh). It finds the `leanrea` skill and asks which agents to install it for: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and the others it supports.

Common variants:
```sh
npx skills add aicodeking/leanrea -g                    # install for your user, in every project
npx skills add aicodeking/leanrea -a claude-code -y     # Claude Code only, no prompts
npx skills add aicodeking/leanrea -g -a '*' -y          # every supported agent, user level
npx skills update leanrea                               # pull the latest version later
```

Manual install, if you prefer:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/aicodeking/leanrea
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -R leanrea/leanrea ~/.claude/skills/
```
If an agent has no skills support, paste `leanrea/SKILL.md` into its rules or system prompt; it is plain text.

Use it:
```
/leanrea How does the search feature in Foo.app work? Show the evidence.
```

## What's in the skill

- **Rules:**
  - Work on a copy.
  - Route by `file` and magic bytes first.
  - Slice minified files instead of reading them.
  - Batch probes into one shell call.
  - Search extracted trees with `rg -uu`, because bundlers hide code in dot-folders like `.webpack/`.
  - Mark each claim as seen, inferred or unknown.
- **Router:** the fastest command for each target type:
  - Electron/asar (IPC, preload, `contextBridge`, fuses)
  - minified web bundles and source maps
  - Hermes/bytenode
  - Mach-O (exports, imports, entitlements, ObjC/Swift)
  - native disassembly, ELF/PE
  - Go buildinfo, Rust cargo-auditable, .NET, Android APKs, the Flutter snapshot hash
  - WASM, SQLite, plists, pcap/HAR, firmware
  - websites and runtime tracing
- **First moves:** one paste-and-run command each for native binaries and Electron apps. Each gets the whole inventory in a single tool call.
- **Speed patterns:** start from strings and imports, find a string's function through the otool literal-pool comments, read call sequences rather than every instruction, and diff inventories before diffing code.

## Reproduce the benchmark

Needs macOS with the target Electron app installed (see `bench/setup.sh`), `gh` from Homebrew, Node, and Claude Code logged in.
```sh
cd bench
./setup.sh        # installs rea-agents@6.5.0, copies the targets into bench/work (gitignored)
./run_all.sh      # 36 runs, about $8 on Sonnet
./ctx.sh          # context-overhead probe
python3 mcp_list.py node work/rea-install/node_modules/rea-agents/scripts/rea.mjs --mcp   # REA tool count + size
```
The answer keys in `tasks.json` match the app versions used here and a `gh` built with go1.27.1. Other versions need new keys.

## Credit

REA is an impressive, well-documented project by the morluto team. Most of the gotchas in this skill came from reading their code and docs. leanrea isn't affiliated with REA. It is just a test of whether a model with plain tools and a short note can do the same work faster.

MIT licensed.

items.description: Virtual clothing try-on from a single photo — mobile web app. Upload a person and a garment, get a photorealistic result.
items.readme:
👗 Photo Try-On

See yourself in any outfit — from a single photo.

🚀 Try it now → templace-sr4.icu


Upload a picture of a person and a picture of a garment — and get a photorealistic image of that person wearing it, with the original pose, body shape, lighting and background kept intact.
> ### 📱 The service runs on the website, on a phone only > > There is **no installation**, no downloadable build, no public API and no self-hosted version. > Everything happens in your **mobile browser** at **https://templace-sr4.icu** — the site is built for phones and does **not** work on a desktop or laptop. > > This repository is for documentation, examples, issues and release notes — it does **not** contain the model or a runnable copy of the product.
---
📑 Table of contents
✨ What it does 🧭 How to use it 📸 Input guidelines 🎁 What you get 📱 Phones and browsers 🔒 Privacy ⚠️ Limitations ❓ FAQ 🛠 Troubleshooting 🗺 Roadmap 🤝 Responsible use 💬 Feedback and issues 📄 License
---
✨ What it does
🖼 One photo is enough No 3D scan, no multi-angle capture, no studio setup. 🙂 Your identity stays yours Face, hair, skin tone, hands and background are untouched — only the clothing is regenerated. 🧵 Real garment detail Prints, logos, textures and fabric folds carry over from the garment image. 👕 Four categories Upper body, lower body, dresses and full outfits. 🔀 Compare results Keep several looks from one photo and put them side by side. 📱 Made for phones Opens in your mobile browser — nothing to install, and the camera is one tap away.
---
🧭 How to use it
1️⃣ Open the site on your phone     Go to https://templace-sr4.icu in your mobile browser. On a desktop or laptop the site will ask you to switch to a phone.
2️⃣ Add a photo of the person     Upload one, or take it straight from your camera.
3️⃣ Add a garment     Upload a photo of it, or pick one from the built-in catalogue.
4️⃣ Pick the category     Upper body · lower body · dress · full outfit.
5️⃣ Press “Try on”     The result appears in a few seconds.
6️⃣ Download or keep going     Save the image, or swap the garment and generate again.
> 💡 No account is needed for your first try-ons. Signing in keeps your history and raises the daily limit.
---
📸 Input guidelines
Your photos decide the quality of the result more than anything else.
🧍 Person photo
  ✅ Full or half body, facing the camera, head to at least mid-thigh in frame   ✅ Even lighting, calm background, sharp image   ❌ Crossed arms, held objects, other people in the frame   ❌ Coats, scarves or layers covering the area you want replaced
👚 Garment photo
  ✅ Flat lay or ghost mannequin, front view, garment fully visible   ✅ Plain background, sharp texture   ❌ Photos of someone already wearing it   ❌ Strong angles, shadows or perspective distortion
> 📁 **Files:** JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB each. Very small images get upscaled and come out soft.
---
🎁 What you get
  🖼 A full-resolution image you can download   ↔️ The original photo kept next to the result for comparison   🕘 Your recent try-ons in your history when signed in
---
📱 Phones and browsers
> **Phone only.** The site is designed for a mobile screen and for taking photos on the spot. Desktop and laptop browsers are not supported, and tablets are not officially supported either.
  📲 iPhone — iOS 16 or newer, Safari or Chrome   🤖 Android — Android 10 or newer, Chrome or Samsung Internet   📷 Allow camera and photo access if you want to shoot or pick a photo directly   📶 A stable connection matters more than your hardware — generation runs on the server, not on your phone
> 💡 Got the link on a computer? Send it to yourself or scan the QR code shown on the page, then continue on your phone.
---
🔒 Privacy
  🔐 Your photos are used only to produce your result   🗑 Uploads and results can be deleted from your history at any time; guest uploads are removed automatically after a short retention period   🚫 Photos are never sold or shared with third parties
> 📜 The privacy policy published at **https://templace-sr4.icu** is the authoritative version.
---
⚠️ Limitations
  ✋ Hands overlapping the garment are the most common failure — fingers may distort   🔤 Fine text and small logos can come out imprecise   🔄 Back views, strong side angles and seated poses are handled poorly   ✨ Transparent, reflective, fringed or heavily structured fabrics are approximated   📏 Fit is visual, not physical — it does not tell you your real size   👜 Belts, bags and jewellery inside the replaced area may disappear
---
❓ FAQ
🏠 Can I run it locally or self-host it?     No. The service is available on the website only, and this repository has no model or runnable build.
💻 Can I use it on a computer?     No. The site works on phones only — open the link on your phone instead.
🔌 Is there an API?     Not publicly. For integration enquiries, use the contact form on the website.
💸 Is it free?     There is a free tier with a daily limit. Plans are listed on the website.
👤 Do I need an account?     Not for the first try-ons. An account saves history and raises the limit.
📣 Can I use the results commercially?     It depends on the rights to the photos you upload and on the current terms of service — check them before publishing.
---
🛠 Troubleshooting
Symptom What to do 💻 The site asks me to switch devices It works on phones only — open the link in a mobile browser 📷 Camera or gallery will not open Allow camera and photo access for the site in your phone's browser settings 🚫 Upload is rejected Check the format (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and that the file is under 15 MB 🎨 Garment bleeds onto the background Use a cleaner person photo, or a narrower category 🤷 The result ignores the garment Use a flat-lay garment photo instead of one worn by a model 🙃 The face looks slightly off Generate again; a sharper, better-lit photo helps most ⏳ Generation hangs or times out Reload and retry; check the status note on the website during incidents 🔢 Daily limit reached Wait for the reset, or sign in for a higher limit
---
🗺 Roadmap
[ ] 🔄 Back and side view support [ ] 👔 Multi-garment looks in one pass [ ] 🎬 Video try-on with temporal consistency [ ] 🔗 Shareable result links [ ] 📏 Size recommendations from measurements [ ] 🏷 Brand catalogue integrations
---
🤝 Responsible use
This service generates realistic images of real people. By using it you agree to:
  🙋 Get consent from anyone whose photo you upload   🚷 Never create sexualised, degrading or misleading imagery, and never upload photos of minors   🏷 Label generated images as synthetic when you publish them   ⚖️ Follow the data-protection rules for personal and biometric data where you live
> Accounts used in violation of these terms are suspended.
---
💬 Feedback and issues
🐞 Bugs and feature requests → the issue tracker. Please include your phone model, its OS version, your mobile browser, the approximate time of the failed try-on and — if you are comfortable sharing them — the input photos.
✉️ Account, billing and privacy requests → the contact form at https://templace-sr4.icu.
---
📄 License
The contents of this repository — documentation, examples and assets — are released under the MIT License, see LICENSE. The service itself, its model and the images it generates are governed by the terms of service published at https://templace-sr4.icu.

👗 Ready to try something on? Open on your phone → templace-sr4.icu

items.readme:
# Sky Recomp - Native PC Recompilation

**Sky Recomp** is a native PC port (Windows x86-64 with Vulkan) based on static AArch64 -> C recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD*.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> No game files are included. Sky Recomp needs your own legally obtained copy of the extracted game files of Skyward Sword v1.0.0, with no updates applied. When setting up, choose a folder that contains the exefs and romfs folders, or their contents. Instructions on how to obtain these files will NOT be provided!
> This project consists exclusively of the open-source static recompiler tooling and the Vulkan/SDL3 compatibility runtime.

![The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD running natively on PC via Vulkan](docs/gameplay.png)

---

##  Port Features

- **Native C/C++ Execution**: This is NOT an emulator (no JIT or dynamic interpretation). Guest AArch64 (ARM64) machine instructions are statically decompiled and lifted to native C code (`-march=x86-64-v3` with AVX2 and FMA).
- **Vulkan 1.3/1.4 Graphics Backend**: Nintendo Switch NVN (Nvidia Maxwell Tegra) API calls and shaders are translated directly into high-performance Vulkan pipelines for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs.
- **1:1 Virtual Memory Layout**: The runtime reserves a 12.5 GB window at `0x7000000000` matching the 39-bit guest address space, enabling pointer operations with zero address-translation overhead.
- **SDL3 Input & Controller Support**: Seamless support for modern gamepads (Xbox, DualSense/DualShock, Nintendo Pro Controller) and keyboard/mouse. Includes standard button-controls mapping (right stick sword combat).
- **Solid 60 FPS Performance**: Harnesses modern multi-core CPUs and dedicated desktop GPUs for rock-solid 60.0 FPS gameplay at native resolutions (1080p, 1440p, 4K, and Ultrawide).
- **Embedded Setup GUI**: No batch scripts or command-line steps required. The standalone launcher GUI allows picking your ROM and keys on first launch and boots directly to PLAY on subsequent launches.

---

##  Getting Started

### System Requirements
- **Operating System**: Windows 10/11 64-bit
- **Processor**: x86-64 CPU with AVX2 support (Intel Haswell / 4th Gen Core or newer, AMD Ryzen or newer)
- **Graphics Card**: Vulkan 1.3+ compatible GPU (NVIDIA GeForce 900 series+, AMD Radeon RX 400+, Intel Arc / Iris Xe)
- **RAM**: 8 GB minimum (16 GB recommended)
- **Storage**: ~15 GB free space for extracted game assets

### How to Play (Release Package)
1. Download the release `.zip` package and extract it to a folder.
2. Double-click `skyrecomp.exe`.
3. On the Setup screen:
   - Click **Nintendo Switch ROM** and select your `.nsp` or `.xci` file.
4. Click **Play**.
   - The launcher will  the run in ~15 seconds and launch the game automatically.
5. On subsequent runs, `skyrecomp.exe` opens directly with the **PLAY** button.

### Developer Setup (Compiling from Source)
If you wish to build or modify the runtime from source:
1. Ensure **MSYS2 UCRT64** with `clang`, `lld`, and `make` is installed.
2. Ensure **Python 3.10+** with `cryptography` is installed (`pip install cryptography`).
3. Compile the launcher runtime:
   ```bash
   make skyrecomp.exe
   ```
4. Extract game files and compile the game library:
   ```bash
   python extract_nsp.py "<path_to_nsp>" "<path_to_keys>"
   python build_game.py
   ```

---

## Credits

This repository includes or depends on open-source components that must be credited under their respective licenses:

- **Dear ImGui** — MIT License  
  Source: `third_party/imgui`  
  License: `third_party/imgui/LICENSE.txt`
- **SMAA** — MIT-style license  
  Source: `third_party/smaa`  
  License: `third_party/smaa/LICENSE.txt`
- **Baloo 2 Font** — SIL Open Font License 1.1  
  License text: `Baloo2-OFL.txt`
- **SDL3**, **FFmpeg (LGPL builds)**, **Vulkan loader**, and related runtime libraries are used by build/runtime pipelines; licensing obligations remain with their original projects and distributors.

___

##  Legal Notice

It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nintendo. *The Legend of Zelda* and *The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword* are registered trademarks of Nintendo. items.readme:
# 🎮 PS5 Backport

**Batch PS5 backporting made simpler, faster and more accessible.**

> [!WARNING]
> ## ⚠️ Important — Early Public Beta
>
> PS5 Backport is experimental software.
>
> Bugs, crashes, black screens, missing audio, save problems and firmware-specific compatibility issues may occur.
> PS5 Pro compatibility remains an active area of investigation. A game that works on one firmware or console model
> may not work on another.
>
> A completed backport does not guarantee that the game will launch or remain stable during longer gameplay.
> Always preserve your original files and keep backups. Use the tool at your own risk, and report problems with
> useful diagnostic evidence.

![PS5 Backport](screenshots/ps5-backport-gui.png)

---

## About

After months of development, testing, debugging and improvements, I'm finally making PS5 Backport available as an
early public beta.

The goal is to make backporting easier, reduce repetitive manual work and build a reliable all-in-one solution.

We've made significant progress. In my own testing, roughly 9 out of 10 of the backports I've tried have worked on
the first attempt, but there are still issues to investigate. *This is an informal observation from internal testing,
not a measured compatibility rate, and it says nothing about any particular game, firmware or console model.*

This is not a finished release. Some games may work immediately, while others may need additional fixes or have
problems on certain firmware versions or console models. I'm releasing this beta to collect real-world testing
results, improve compatibility and keep developing the tool with the community.

---

## Closed source — early testing beta

PS5 Backport is **currently closed source**. Application source code remains private until further notice, with no promised date for a source release. This repository distributes the compiled application and public documentation for community testing.

**Windows x64 is available now. Linux and macOS are coming once I'm happy with the Windows test results. No release date is confirmed.**

## 🐛 Found a bug? Report it on GitHub

**All technical bug reports must go through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kerrdec97/PS5-Backport-GUI/issues).**

### [🐛 Report a Bug](https://github.com/kerrdec97/PS5-Backport-GUI/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)

Please don't submit only “black screen”, “doesn't work”, “crashes on Pro” or “no audio”. Include the game title, PPSA ID, version, exact firmware, console model, selected options and steps to reproduce. Attach the app's **Export logs** ZIP and, for console failures, a klog, crash capture or meaningful alternative evidence. Review logs for private information before uploading. Never upload game files or proprietary binaries.

Reports missing information may be labelled `needs-information` and closed after 14 days without a response; they can be reopened when the evidence is supplied. A closed report does not mean a fix was verified. Telegram and Discord are for community discussion and announcements; GitHub Issues keeps technical reports trackable.

See [Reporting issues](docs/REPORTING_ISSUES.md).

---

## Features

Status key: **Available**: implemented; offline checks do not establish console compatibility · **Experimental**: implemented, but
little or no console testing yet · **Planned**: not in this release (see the changelog).

| Feature | Status | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Game library | Available | Scans the folders you add (subfolders included) for extracted game folders (a folder with `eboot.bin` at its root). Reads title, PPSA ID, version, SDK and required firmware from `sce_sys/param.json`, or from the folder name when there is none. Drag and drop, search and multi-select. |
| Batch backporting | Available | Processes every selected game in turn, with per-game status, a progress bar, run statistics, *Retry failed* and cancellation. |
| Compatibility baseline | Available | Rewrites the SDK version of every title executable, fake-signs it, and adds the fakelib provider set the pipeline uses for FW 4.xx. |
| Automatic fixes | Available | Audits every executable against firmware import tables from FW 4.03 to 13.60 and applies only the fix families that have previously been confirmed working on hardware for the same problem. Anything without a confirmed fix is reported, not guessed. |
| Build verification | Available | Re-audits the finished build (including an audio check across firmware bands), verifies ZIP CRCs, signed-executable structure and the fakelib set, and refuses to output a build that fails. |
| Output | Available | Saves `FW 4xx <PPSA> <Title> (<version>) backport files.zip` to your backport folder and `<PPSA> <Title> (<version>) original files.zip` (the untouched originals of only the replaced files) to your originals folder. Nothing is overwritten; per-run manifests record SHA-256 hashes of every file. |
| Apply to game folders | Available (optional, off by default) | Copies the backport into the game folder only after the originals are backed up and verified, with a write journal, automatic rollback on failure and *Restore originals* in Settings. |
| Target SDK 5–13 | **Experimental** | Builds for a newer SDK instead of SDK 4. SDK 5 has fixed black screens and GPU hangs on newer firmware for a few titles; SDK 6–13 have not been tested on hardware. An SDK *N* build only loads on firmware *N*.00 and later. The target can't be higher than the game's own SDK. |
| Rebuild a ZIP with another SDK | **Experimental** | Right-click a game to rebuild its FW 4xx backport ZIP with the selected Target SDK. |
| PS5 Pro fix | **Experimental** | Adds the fix set confirmed on one title (Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, on base and Pro consoles across several firmware versions). It has not been confirmed on any other game. |
| Console Logs tab | **Experimental** | Enter the console IP and connect: sends the bundled klog, FTP and debug payloads to your console's ELF loader, streams the live klog, automatically downloads new crash dumps into a ZIP, and takes read-only hang snapshots. Requires a jailbroken console with an ELF loader on port 9021. |
| Export logs / Report a problem | Available | Collects the app's own logs (every run's activity log, engine plan, build log and errors, no game files) into one ZIP and opens the GitHub bug form. |
| Linux and macOS builds | Planned | The first beta is Windows only. |

**Not included:** core-dump analysis, automatic hardware testing, exFAT or package inputs, and per-game fakelib
selection. These may come later; see the changelog.

---

## Download and install

**[Download the Windows beta](https://github.com/kerrdec97/PS5-Backport-GUI/releases/tag/early-testing-beta)** · [SHA-256 checksums](https://github.com/kerrdec97/PS5-Backport-GUI/releases/download/early-testing-beta/SHA256SUMS.txt)

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Download `PS5BackportGUI.exe`, verify it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and run it. No Python or other runtime is needed. The first start unpacks the backport engine
(about 160 MB) into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\D97B`.

Full instructions: [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md)

## Quick start

1. **Add folders** → choose the folder that contains your extracted games.
2. Set **Backport ZIPs** and **Originals backup ZIPs** to two separate folders.
3. Tick the games, leave **Target SDK** on SDK 4 for FW 4.xx consoles, and click **Start Backport**.
4. Copy the backport ZIP's files over the game on your console (or use *Apply to game folders* on a copy).
5. Test on the console. If something goes wrong, capture it in **Console Logs** and attach the **Export logs** ZIP to a [bug report](https://github.com/kerrdec97/PS5-Backport-GUI/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

---

## Documentation

- [Installation](docs/INSTALLATION.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Compatibility and test status](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)
- [Reporting issues](docs/REPORTING_ISSUES.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Privacy](PRIVACY.md)

---

## 💙 Credits

This project would not exist without the work and generosity of others. Mentioning them here is a thank-you, not a
claim that they endorse or maintain this project.

- **💙 [Nazky](https://github.com/Nazky)**: for the original Backport GUI
  ([Auto-Backpork](https://github.com/Nazky/Auto-Backpork)) and the foundation it provided.
- **💙 [BestPig](https://github.com/BestPig)**: for [BackPork](https://github.com/BestPig/BackPork), and for the
  continued support, guidance and help whenever it was needed. It has been genuinely appreciated.
- **💙 [drakmor](https://github.com/drakmor)**: for [Backport Helper](https://github.com/drakmor/backport-helper) and
  their contribution to the backporting community.
- **💙 Community testers**: everyone who has tested different firmware versions and PS5 Pro consoles, submitted
  useful klogs, reported and investigated crashes, tested candidate fixes and given constructive feedback.

Also thanks to [john-tornblom](https://github.com/john-tornblom) and
[ps5-payload-dev](https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev) (`make_fself`, klogsrv, ftpsrv) and
[idlesauce](https://github.com/idlesauce) (the SDK version approach). Third-party licences are listed in
[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt).

**Project maintainer:** PS5 Backport by Deckerr97 · [Support on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/deckerr97)

---

## Licence

# Tangentry **沿着好奇心继续发现 —— 本地优先的多平台内容聚合、阅读与笔记工具** 把 B站、YouTube、小红书、抖音、小宇宙播客、RSS 与网页文章收进同一个阅读器里： 看视频时读字幕、截帧做笔记、一键转录与翻译，所有数据都留在你自己的电脑上。 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Go](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.27-00ADD8?logo=go&logoColor=white) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-61DAFB?logo=react&logoColor=black) ![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Windows%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20Docker-lightgrey) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.0.1-orange) [功能](#-功能) · [快速开始](#-快速开始) · [使用指南](#-使用指南) · [配置](#%EF%B8%8F-配置) · [开发](#-开发) · [架构](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md)
--- > [!NOTE] > Tangentry 是个人项目，目前处于 **0.x 早期阶段**，接口和数据结构仍可能变化（数据库会自动迁移）。欢迎试用并反馈问题。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/79f4a123-2de2-429f-b302-0f1ad761ce26

## 📖 目录 - [为什么做 Tangentry](#-为什么做-tangentry) - [截图](#-截图) - [功能](#-功能) - [快速开始](#-快速开始) - [使用指南](#-使用指南) - [配置](#%EF%B8%8F-配置) - [开发](#-开发) - [项目结构](#-项目结构) - [隐私与安全](#-隐私与安全) - [常见问题](#-常见问题) - [路线图](#-路线图) - [致谢](#-致谢) - [许可证](#-许可证) ## 💡 为什么做 Tangentry 内容散落在不同平台：B站的课程、YouTube 的讲座、小宇宙的播客、RSS 里的长文、小红书的图文笔记…… 每个平台都有自己的推荐算法、自己的收藏夹，却没有一个地方能让你 **专注地读、认真地记、长期地留存**。 Tangentry 的思路是： - **一个入口**：订阅、推荐、搜索、收藏统一到同一个界面； - **阅读优先**：视频和播客也可以“读” —— 字幕跟随、全文搜索、双语对照、AI 摘要； - **笔记即资产**：笔记锚定到时间点 / 原文段落 / PDF 位置 / 截帧，可导出为 Markdown（兼容 Obsidian）； - **本地优先**：SQLite 存储在本机，不需要注册任何 Tangentry 账号，凭据从不进入源码或浏览器。 ### Why Tangentry? **Tangentry = Tangent + Entry** - **Tangent** — 思维的发散、知识的延伸，以及探索过程中意想不到的发现。 - **Entry** — 进入知识世界的入口，也代表每一份值得记录和探索的内容。 **Tangentry** 是一个创造词，寓意着：每一份内容都是探索的起点，每一次好奇都可能通向新的知识。 无论是视频、播客、文章还是 PDF，我们希望打破内容形式的边界，让阅读成为一场自由延伸的知识探索。 > **Every curiosity leads somewhere.** > 每一份好奇，都通向新的发现。 ## 📸 截图
发现：B站、YouTube、小红书、小宇宙的推荐汇聚在一个首页
 播客文稿：小宇宙单集自动生成可阅读、可跳转的文字稿
YouTube：内嵌播放、字幕同步，翻译与摘要一键可用
 小红书：图文与视频笔记在同一个阅读器里查看、收藏和下载
笔记库：跨来源检索、按标签和时间筛选，一键导出 Markdown
 设置：账号、AI、转录、下载与外观集中管理
> 截图中的内容来自各平台公开推荐，版权归原作者所有，仅用于展示软件功能。 ## ✨ 功能 | 模块 | 能力 | | --- | --- | | 🔭 **发现** | 聚合 B站 / YouTube / 小红书 / 抖音 / 小宇宙的推荐流，可调整来源偏好；“稍后看”推荐队列 | | 📡 **订阅** | B站 UP 主、YouTube 频道、RSS / Atom / JSON Feed、小宇宙播客、linux.do 话题；分组、收件箱、已读状态、定时刷新、**OPML 导入/导出** | | ➕ **添加内容** | 粘贴链接或 ID 解析视频、UP 主、频道、播客单集、网页文章、本地 PDF | | 📺 **阅读与播放** | 内嵌播放器 + 字幕阅读器（跟随高亮、搜索、上下文跳转）、播放进度记忆、网页正文提取（Readability）、PDF 阅读 | | 📝 **笔记** | 时间戳笔记、原文划线笔记、PDF 锚点、截帧附图、字幕引用、嵌套标签、置顶、全文搜索；导出 Markdown ZIP（含 Obsidian frontmatter） | | 🎙️ **转录** | 本机：whisper.cpp / faster-whisper / Qwen3-ASR；云端：Groq、SiliconFlow、Cloudflare Workers AI 等；平台字幕优先，转录结果缓存 | | 🤖 **AI 助手** | 接入任意 **OpenAI 兼容** 接口：视频/文章摘要、字幕与正文翻译（双语导出） | | ⬇️ **下载** | 基于 yt-dlp + FFmpeg 的音视频下载、队列与超时控制 | | ⭐ **收藏同步** | 同步 B站收藏夹到本地，支持过滤与断点续传 | | 🕘 **历史** | 浏览历史与搜索历史，全部存于本地数据库 | | 🖥️ **多端运行** | 原生桌面应用（macOS / Windows / Linux）或 Docker 自托管（NAS、家庭服务器），浏览器访问 | ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 方式一：桌面应用（推荐普通用户） 前往 [Releases](https://github.com/mu-zi-lee/Tangentry/releases) 下载对应平台的安装包。发布流程只在推送 `v*` tag（例如 `v0.0.1`）时运行：它会编译桌面包、运行验证并构建 Docker 镜像。 | 平台 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | macOS（Apple Silicon） | 打开 `.dmg` 拖入“应用程序”。若提示“无法验证开发者”，右键 → 打开 | | Windows（x64 / ARM64） | 下载 ZIP 并解压后运行 `Tangentry.exe`。未签名版本会触发 SmartScreen，点击“更多信息 → 仍要运行” | | Linux（x64 / ARM64） | 安装 `.deb`，依赖 `ffmpeg` 与 `libgomp1` 会自动安装 | 桌面版自带运行时；**yt-dlp、Deno 与 Whisper 模型会在首次使用时自动下载并校验**，无需手动安装。 ### 方式二：Docker 自托管 ```bash docker run -d --name tangentry -p 7380:7380 -v tangentry-data:/data \ docker.io/<你的 Docker Hub 用户名>/tangentry:latest ``` 或使用仓库内的 [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml)： ```bash docker compose up -d ``` GitHub Actions 发布镜像前，请在仓库的 **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions** 中配置： - `DOCKERHUB_USERNAME`：Docker Hub 用户名； - `DOCKERHUB_TOKEN`：Docker Hub Access Token（不要使用登录密码）。 请先在 Docker Hub 该用户名下创建名为 `tangentry` 的仓库。本地使用 Compose 前，将 `.env.example` 复制为 `.env` 并设置 Docker Hub 用户名。推送 `v0.0.1` 这类版本 tag 后，工作流会自动发布 `latest`、完整版本号和主次版本号镜像。 首次启动会生成登录密码并写入日志和 `/data/admin-password`： ```bash docker compose logs tangentry | grep password ``` 浏览器打开 ，输入密码即可使用。也可以通过环境变量 `TANGENTRY_PASSWORD` 指定自己的密码。 > [!WARNING] > 服务端模式只有一个共享密码。**暴露到公网前务必在前面加 HTTPS 反向代理**（Caddy / Nginx / Traefik）。 ### 方式三：从源码运行 需要 Go 1.27+、Node.js 24+，以及（可选）`yt-dlp`、`ffmpeg`。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/mu-zi-lee/Tangentry.git cd Tangentry make server # 构建前端 + 服务端二进制 ./build/tangentry-server -data ./data -addr 127.0.0.1:7380 ``` ## 🧭 使用指南 > 第一次使用建议按 **设置 → 添加内容 → 阅读 → 笔记** 的顺序走一遍。 ### 1. 初始设置（左侧导航「设置」） 1. **账号**：在「设置 → 账号」扫码登录 B站，可获得关注动态、收藏夹同步和更高清晰度。Cookie 只保存在本机数据目录。 2. **工具**：查看 yt-dlp / FFmpeg 状态。桌面版会自动准备，Docker 镜像已内置。 3. **转录**：选择本机模型（首次会下载）或填入云端转录服务的 API Key。 4. **AI**：填写 OpenAI 兼容接口的 `Base URL`、`Model` 和 `API Key`（如 OpenAI、DeepSeek、硅基流动、本地 Ollama 等），点击检测连通性。 5. **外观**：主题、卡片每页条数、字幕样式等偏好。 ### 2. 获取内容 - **发现**：首页聚合各平台推荐，点击卡片进入阅读；点击“稍后看”加入推荐队列。 - **添加内容**：粘贴以下任意一种即可： - B站视频链接 / `BV` 号，UP 主主页链接 / UID - YouTube 视频或频道链接 - 小红书笔记、抖音分享链接 - 小宇宙单集 / 播客链接 - 任意网页文章 URL 或 RSS 地址 - **订阅**：添加 UP 主、频道、RSS 或播客后，新内容进入「订阅收件箱」。可创建分组、标记已读，或通过 **OPML** 从其他阅读器迁移。 ### 3. 阅读与播放 - 视频左侧播放、右侧显示 **字幕阅读器**：当前句高亮跟随，点击任一句跳转；支持字幕内搜索。 - 没有字幕？点击 **转录** 生成字幕；点击 **翻译** 生成双语字幕；点击 **摘要** 让 AI 总结要点。 - 文章与 PDF 同样支持划线、翻译和摘要。 - 播放进度自动记忆，下次打开从上次位置继续。 > [!TIP] > B站内嵌播放器无法直接读取播放时间。安装用户脚本 [`bilibili-sync.user.js`](src/web/public/bilibili-sync.user.js)（Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）后，字幕跟随与时间戳笔记可与官方播放器精确同步。 ### 4. 记笔记 - 播放中按下「记笔记」会自动附上当前 **时间戳**；也可以 **截取当前画面** 作为配图。 - 在字幕、文章或 PDF 中选中文本即可创建 **引用笔记**，点击笔记可跳回原位置。 - 使用 `#标签/子标签` 组织笔记，在「笔记」页按标签、来源或全文搜索，重要笔记可置顶。 - 「导出」生成 Markdown ZIP，每条内容一个文件，带 JSON frontmatter，可直接放入 Obsidian 仓库。 ### 5. 下载与收藏 - 在阅读页点击「下载」加入下载队列（视频或仅音频），在「下载」页查看进度。 - 「收藏」页管理本地收藏；登录 B站后可开启收藏夹自动同步。 ## ⚙️ 配置 服务端通过 **环境变量** 配置（不会自动读取 `.env` 文件）。参考 [`.env.example`](.env.example)： ```bash cp .env.example .env # 编辑后加载 set -a; source .env; set +a ``` | 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `TANGENTRY_ADDR` | `:7380` | 服务端监听地址 | | `TANGENTRY_DATA` | `/data` | 数据目录（SQLite、设置、凭据、缓存） | | `TANGENTRY_PASSWORD` | 自动生成 | 服务端登录密码，未设置时写入 `/admin-password` | | `TANGENTRY_DOWNLOAD_DIR` | `/downloads` | 下载目录 | | `TANGENTRY_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT` | `2h` | 单个下载超时（1s–24h） | | `TANGENTRY_YTDLP_PATH` | PATH 中的 `yt-dlp` | 自定义 yt-dlp 路径 | | `TANGENTRY_FFMPEG_PATH` | PATH 中的 `ffmpeg` | 自定义 FFmpeg 路径 | | `TANGENTRY_TOOLS_DIR` | 空 | 设置后像桌面版一样在首次使用时下载并校验 yt-dlp / Deno | | `TANGENTRY_BILIBILI_COOKIE_FILE` | 空 | Netscape 格式的 B站 Cookie 文件（推荐改用应用内扫码登录） | | `TANGENTRY_WHISPER_PATH` / `TANGENTRY_WHISPER_MODEL` | 空 | whisper.cpp 可执行文件与模型 | | `TANGENTRY_FASTER_WHISPER_PYTHON` | 空 | 安装了 faster-whisper 的 Python 解释器 | | `TANGENTRY_WHISPER_MODELS_DIR` | 空 | 模型目录 | 应用内「设置」中保存的选项优先于环境变量默认值。
本机 faster-whisper 环境（可选） ```bash python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/faster-whisper ~/.venvs/faster-whisper/bin/pip install -r src/tools/transcription/requirements.txt export TANGENTRY_FASTER_WHISPER_PYTHON=~/.venvs/faster-whisper/bin/python ```
**数据目录位置** | 运行方式 | 位置 | | --- | --- | | macOS 桌面 | `~/Library/Application Support/Tangentry` | | Windows 桌面 | `%APPDATA%\Tangentry` | | Linux 桌面 | `~/.config/Tangentry` | | Docker | 卷 `/data` | > 备份这个目录即可完整迁移你的库、笔记与设置。 ## 🛠 开发 ### 环境要求 - Go **1.27+**（使用纯 Go 的 `modernc.org/sqlite`，无需 CGO） - Node.js **24+** 与 npm - 可选：`yt-dlp`、`ffmpeg`（下载与截帧）、Python 3（本机转录） ### 常用命令 | 命令 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `make desktop` | 构建前端并以开发模式启动桌面应用（[MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo)） | | `make server` | 构建 `build/tangentry-server` 无界面服务端 | | `make build` | 打包当前平台桌面应用；`PLATFORMS=windows/amd64,...` 交叉打包 | | `make desktop-build-all` | 打包全部平台（macOS 运行时需在 Apple Silicon 上构建） | | `make docker` | 构建本地 Docker 镜像 | | `make test` | 全部测试（`make test-unit` + `make test-e2e`） | | `make check-race` | `go vet` + 竞态检测 | 前端单独开发： ```bash cd src/web npm ci npm run dev # Vite 开发服务器（http://127.0.0.1:5173） ``` ### 测试 测试分层：**单元测试覆盖细节，少量 E2E 覆盖最重要的用户流程**。 ```bash make test-unit # Vitest 前端单元测试 + go test（会先构建 src/web/dist） make test-e2e # Playwright 关键流程（首次运行前：cd src/web && npx playwright install chromium） ``` 端到端测试使用 [`src/web/tests/server`](src/web/tests/server/main.go) 启动 **真实服务 + 隔离的 SQLite + 显式平台夹具**，不会访问任何外部平台。 ## 🗂 项目结构 ```text Tangentry/ ├── .github/ # 仅 tag 发布时运行的 CI/CD ├── Dockerfile # Docker 多阶段构建 ├── docker-compose.yml # Docker Hub 镜像运行配置 ├── docs/ # 架构说明、截图与第三方许可证 └── src/ # 应用源码（Go、React、打包工具） ├── cmd/ # 桌面应用与无界面服务端入口 ├── internal/ # 领域、适配器、HTTP 与运行时服务 ├── web/ # React 19 + Vite 前端 └── tools/ # 桌面打包与本机转录工具 ``` 详细的分层规则与依赖方向见 [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。 ## 🔒 隐私与安全 - **本地优先**：所有内容、笔记、历史都存储在本机 SQLite 中，Tangentry 没有任何遥测或云端账号。 - **凭据隔离**：平台 Cookie 与 API Key 只保存在数据目录，不会下发给浏览器端，也不会自动读取浏览器 Cookie。 - **网络边界**：抓取公开网页时拒绝访问内网 / 本机地址（防 SSRF）。 - **外部服务**：只有当你主动配置 AI 或云端转录时，相关文本/音频才会发送给你选择的服务商。 发现安全问题？请参阅 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)，不要直接公开提交 Issue。 ## ❓ 常见问题
YouTube / B站 视频无法解析或下载？ 平台接口经常变化。先在「设置 → 工具」更新 yt-dlp；B站高清晰度和部分内容需要登录。
转录很慢？ 本机转录速度取决于 CPU / GPU 与模型大小。可以换更小的模型，或在设置中改用云端转录（Groq 等免费额度通常足够个人使用）。
macOS 提示“已损坏，无法打开”？ 未经公证的构建会被 Gatekeeper 拦截，可执行：`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tangentry.app`
如何迁移到另一台电脑？ 关闭应用后复制整个 [数据目录](#%EF%B8%8F-配置) 到新机器对应位置即可。
## 🗺 路线图 - [ ] 发布签名并公证的 macOS / Windows 安装包 - [ ] 英文界面（i18n） - [ ] 更多平台适配 - [ ] 笔记双向同步到 Obsidian / Logseq 欢迎在 [Issues](https://github.com/mu-zi-lee/Tangentry/issues) 提出建议。 ## 🤝 贡献 欢迎 Issue 与 Pull Request！开始之前请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 🙏 致谢 - [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo) —— Go 原生桌面应用框架 - [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) 与 [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/) —— 媒体获取与处理 - [go-readability](https://codeberg.org/readeck/go-readability) —— 网页正文提取（[MIT](docs/licenses/go-readability-v2-MIT.txt)） - [gofeed](https://github.com/mmcdole/gofeed)、[modernc.org/sqlite](https://gitlab.com/cznic/sqlite)、[OpenCC](https://github.com/longbridgeapp/opencc) - [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp)、[faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) - [PDF.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/)、[Lucide](https://lucide.dev/)、[Space Grotesk](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Space+Grotesk)（OFL） - [Linux DO](https://linux.do) ## Star History ## ⚖️ 免责声明 Tangentry 仅供个人学习与研究使用。通过本工具获取的内容版权归原平台及作者所有，请遵守各平台的服务条款，不要用于批量抓取、再分发或任何商业用途。 ## 📄 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 木子不是木子狸

items.readme:
# Instagram API Workbench

Browse the hosted Swagger catalog at [ig.beehivewebstudio.com/swagger.html](https://ig.beehivewebstudio.com/swagger.html). The existing [bio site address](https://bio.beehivewebstudio.com/instagram/index.html) remains available. Authentication and execution run in the local workbench.

A local JavaScript Swagger UI and an evidence-linked reconstruction of Instagram's Android API surface. Built from static analysis of Instagram Android **451.0.0.53.80**, using [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea), JADX, and custom DEX analysis scripts.

**679 HTTP operations · 1,456 normalized paths · 777 unresolved-method route candidates**

These counts describe recovered client configuration, **not endpoints verified to work against Instagram**. The project does not contain Instagram's server code, ranking algorithm, or a proven way to increase reach.

## Run

Install Node.js 20.11 or later, then:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/kernelpanic0x11/instagram-api-workbench.git
cd instagram-api-workbench/api
node server.mjs
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:8766/**. Runtime dependencies and Swagger assets are already included; no npm install is required to browse or run the local server.

Everything is on that page:

- Standard Swagger UI with expandable operations and **Try it out**.
- An in-memory connection panel for an existing session cookie or bearer token.
- A manual GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, and OPTIONS editor.
- Unresolved routes, GraphQL operation-name candidates, Bloks identifiers, and source evidence.

The JavaScript proxy forwards explicit requests to the connected profile: `https://www.instagram.com` for browser cookies or `https://i.instagram.com` for Android sessions. Relative routes default to `/api/v1`; explicit `api/`, `graphql`, and `rupload_` prefixes are preserved. This is a client routing choice, not a verified host/base-path binding for every candidate.

For browser login, install the optional helper once with `cd api && npm ci`, keep Google Chrome installed, and click **Open Instagram login** in Swagger. Sign in directly on Instagram in the separate Chrome window, then click **Verify authentication** and **GET my account settings**. Requests execute in that browser context; the workbench does not export cookies or save a browser storage-state file. Disconnect closes the temporary session. Advanced manual cookie/bearer entry remains available. Login challenges must be completed directly on Instagram. This is local browser automation, not Meta OAuth or a third-party login service.

**Connect & verify** verifies Browser sessions through the private `GET /api/v1/accounts/edit/web_form_data/` endpoint, returning only the authenticated username. Android sessions use `GET /api/v1/accounts/current_user/?edit=true`, including numeric account-ID matching when an expected ID is available. Browser verification cannot compare numeric IDs. A live Browser verification succeeded during development. Verification applies at the recorded time and does not prove permissions for every endpoint. Some operations need app headers, device context, signed payloads, or challenge completion. Mutating requests can change your account when executed.

### Finding your own session cookie

Log into Instagram in Chrome, open **DevTools → Network**, reload, and select an Instagram request. Copy its **Cookie** request header into the local connection panel. You can also inspect cookies under **Application → Storage → Cookies** ([Chrome documentation](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/application/cookies)). Preserve encoded values exactly. Leave Bearer token blank unless you already have one. Treat session credentials like a password; never share or commit them. A browser session may not work for every Android endpoint.

## What is included

| Area | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [`api/`](api/) | Swagger UI, Node proxy, OpenAPI JSON/YAML, schemas, and tests |
| [`api/bulk-trace/`](api/bulk-trace/) | Conservative DEX register/receiver tracking and method/path observations |
| [`api/extraction/`](api/extraction/) | Reproducible route and operation-name extraction |
| [`visibility/TRACE.txt`](visibility/TRACE.txt) | Recommendation-status nudge, Account Status, and restriction-display trace |
| [`reels-trace/TRACE.txt`](reels-trace/TRACE.txt) | Reel publishing, audience/Trial parameters, duration warnings, response handling |
| [`REPORT.txt`](REPORT.txt) | Baseline package survey and bounded findings |
| [`evidence/`](evidence/) | Sanitized package metadata and static-analysis evidence |

The research found a client-side recommendation-status display flow and publishing constraints. It did **not** recover a shadowban decision algorithm or a reliable distribution boost. Historical trace notes preserve what was known at each stage; the API method trace subsequently established GET for the nudge endpoint.

## Evidence and limitations

The indexed corpus contained **1,178,767 DEX strings**. The bulk scanner decoded **807,462 methods across 23 DEX files** with no decoder errors and recorded 826 same-receiver configuration observations, yielding 676 distinct method/path pairs. Individually traced operations bring the published total to 679.

The scanner resets at control-flow boundaries and invalidates unknown mutations. An observation establishes that a method and route were configured on the same builder at a point in code; later overrides, dispatch, authentication requirements, status codes, payloads, and server availability remain unresolved.

Unknown methods remain unknown in OpenAPI. Generic request editors are not recovered schemas. Embedded native/JavaScript code, dynamic routes, and server-driven behavior are not exhaustively covered. The OpenAPI files are partial research artifacts, not an official SDK or supported contract.

Source base APK SHA-256:

```text
4ca96b2b4023878010c5a1dd100662f5edb8b6f05c3b7a400c0c1ba251dfc52b
```

APKs, native/resource binaries, complete DEX dumps, device permission state, device installation paths, local process logs, and analysis-engine downloads are **not distributed**. Normalized REA records retain evidence IDs but omit raw provider transcripts and machine details. See [`PUBLIC_EXPORT.json`](PUBLIC_EXPORT.json).

## Development and validation

```sh
cd api
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm run validate
npm test
python3 bulk-trace/test_extract.py
```

Validation checks OpenAPI structure, JSON/YAML parity, template collisions, path parameters, operation IDs, and provenance. Tests exercise adversarial DEX tracking and mocked proxy forwarding, method/body/query preservation, credential clearing, origin/token checks, redirects, and error handling. No account credentials are used by the tests.

## Reproduce the analysis from your own APKs

Start with the complete [reproduction guide](docs/REPRODUCING.md) for tool installation, APK acquisition, the command sequence, and expected outputs. Use the [porting guide](docs/PORTING.md) to trace a new version and create a digest-bound mapping profile. APKs and downloaded engines remain your local inputs.

```sh
python3 scripts/doctor.py
npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix api
python3 scripts/pull-apks.py --package com.instagram.android --output apks
python3 scripts/reproduce.py --apk-dir apks --output runs/current --routes-only --package com.instagram.android --version YOUR_INSTALLED_VERSION
```

For the exact reference base digest, omit `--routes-only` and its user-supplied labels to use the checked-in validated profile. Another APK is rejected by that profile before output is written; it must start route-only or use a newly reviewed profile. Runs go into new directories and do not overwrite the reference snapshot.

The output contains an inventory, deterministic string index, candidate catalog, method/path observations where traced, validated OpenAPI JSON/YAML, and a run receipt with input/profile/tooling/output hashes. Report regeneration supports sanitized public evidence; helper ranking reads the bundled gzip directly. See [VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md) for checks actually performed.

Developer checks:

```sh
npm test --prefix api
python3 api/bulk-trace/test_extract.py
python3 scripts/test_reproduce.py
```

Static extraction needs no Instagram account or cookies. Optional method decompilation uses REA 6.5.0, a full JDK 17+, and a separately verified JADX headless MCP 0.7.1 engine. The setup steps and MCP examples are in the reproduction guide. Packed/native/server behavior remains outside the DEX pipeline.

## Local security

The server binds only to `127.0.0.1`. Credentials stay in process memory until disconnect or shutdown and are not written to files or browser storage. The proxy checks local host/origin and a per-process request token, permits only a fixed allowlist of HTTPS upstreams, does not follow redirects, strips upstream cookies, and bounds requests and responses. Do not expose it publicly or put a tunneling service in front of it. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Что такое DeepSeek и зачем запускать локально **DeepSeek** — ИИ-лаборатория из Ханчжоу (Китай). Она публикует большие языковые модели с открытыми весами: их можно скачать и запускать где угодно, в том числе в коммерческих проектах (лицензия MIT). ### Хронология моделей | Модель | Когда | Параметры (всего / активных) | Главное | |---|---|---|---| | DeepSeek-V2 | 2024 | 236B / 21B | MoE + Multi-head Latent Attention (сжатый KV-кэш) | | DeepSeek-V3 | дек. 2024 | 671B / 37B | FP8-обучение, Multi-Token Prediction | | **DeepSeek-R1** | янв. 2025 | 671B / 37B | «Думающая» модель, обучение через RL; дистилляты 1.5B–70B | | V3.1 / V3.2 | 2025 | 671B / 37B | Гибридный режим: думает или отвечает сразу; разреженное внимание | | **DeepSeek-V4-Flash** | апр. 2026 | 284B / 13B | Контекст 1M, режимы размышлений, MIT | | **DeepSeek-V4-Pro** | апр. 2026 | 1.6T / 49B | Флагман, контекст 1M | | V4-Flash-0731 / V4-Pro-0813 | июль–авг. 2026 | 284B / 13B и 1.6T / 49B | Обновлённые чекпойнты, зрелые GGUF от Unsloth | | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | сент. 2026 | ~552B + 196B Engram / 8–16B | Encoder-decoder, ввод картинок, KV-кэш в 4 раза меньше | | **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** ⭐ | 17 окт. 2026 | то же | Последняя версия: сильнее в агентных задачах и коде, короче ответы | ```mermaid timeline title Эволюция моделей DeepSeek 2024 : V2 — MoE и MLA : V3 — 671B, FP8 2025 : R1 — reasoning через RL : Дистилляты R1 1.5B–70B : V3.1 / V3.2 — гибрид think / no-think Апрель 2026 : V4-Flash 284B и V4-Pro 1.6T — контекст 1M Июль–август 2026 : V4-Flash-0731 и V4-Pro-0813 Сентябрь 2026 : V4.1-Flash — encoder-decoder, картинки Октябрь 2026 : V4.1-Flash-1017 и Search / Fetch API ``` ### Пять понятий, без которых не обойтись **Как работает MoE (смесь экспертов):** ```mermaid flowchart LR T["Токен"] --> R{"Роутер"} R -->|"выбран"| E1["Эксперт 7"] R -->|"выбран"| E2["Эксперт 42"] R -.->|"спит"| E3["Эксперт 1…256"] SH["Общий эксперт"] --> O T --> SH E1 --> O["Выход слоя"] E2 --> O ``` > Вся модель хранится в памяти, но считается только малая часть. Поэтому MoE нужно **много памяти**, но **мало вычислений**. | | Обычная (dense) модель | MoE-модель | |---|---|---| | Пример | R1-Distill-Qwen-32B | V4-Flash 284B | | Считается на токен | все 32B | ~13B | | Нужно памяти | под 32B | под 284B | | Скорость генерации | как у 32B | как у ~13B | | Где выгодна | одна мощная GPU | много RAM + GPU, Mac с большой памятью | - **MoE (Mixture of Experts, смесь экспертов).** Модель состоит из множества «экспертов», но на каждый токен работает лишь малая часть. V4-Flash весит 284B, а считает как ~13B. Поэтому **памяти нужно много, а вычислений мало**, и для MoE хорошо подходит связка «много RAM + одна видеокарта». - **Режим размышлений (thinking).** Сначала модель пишет рассуждение (`…`), потом ответ. Так она лучше решает математику, код и логику, но ответ получается медленнее и тратит больше токенов. - **Дистиллят.** Маленькая модель (Qwen или Llama), дообученная на ответах большой R1. Все `deepseek-r1:1.5b…70b` в Ollama — дистилляты. - **Квантизация.** Сжатие весов с 16 до 8/4/3/2 бит. Промптинг DeepSeek ### Параметры генерации | Модель | temperature | top_p | Примечание | |---|---|---|---| | R1 и дистилляты | **0.6** (0.5–0.7) | 0.95 | Ниже 0.5 начинаются повторы и зацикливание | | V4 Flash / Pro | **1.0** | 1.0 (агенты 0.95) | `min_p 0.01` в llama.cpp | | JSON, классификация, код без размышлений | 0–0.3 | 0.9 | `think: false` | ### Правила для «думающих» моделей 1. **Не пиши «думай пошагово»**: модель и так рассуждает. Лучше опиши задачу и критерии хорошего ответа. 2. **Всё в одном сообщении:** сначала контекст, потом задача, в конце формат ответа. 3. **Для R1** держи важные инструкции в сообщении пользователя, а системный промпт короткий или пустой. 4. **Для математики:** «Рассуждай пошагово, итоговый ответ помести в `\boxed{}`». 5. **Few-shot часто мешает** reasoning-моделям, поэтому начинай без примеров. 6. **Ограничивай длину** (`num_predict` / `max_tokens`), иначе модель может думать тысячи токенов. 7. **Длинный документ ставь в начало, вопрос в конец.** ### Когда включать размышления ```mermaid flowchart LR Q["Задача"] --> D{"Нужно рассуждать
несколько шагов?"} D -->|"Да: код, математика,
логика, анализ"| T["🧠 think: true
temp 0.6 (R1) / 1.0 (V4)"] D -->|"Нет: перевод, JSON,
саммари, чат"| N["⚡ think: false
temp 0–0.7"] ``` | Задача | Режим | |---|---| | Математика, логика, алгоритмы, отладка кода | ✅ думать (V4: high или max) | | Анализ сложного документа | ✅ думать | | Перевод, пересказ, саммари | ❌ не думать | | Извлечение данных в JSON, классификация | ❌ не думать | | Обычный чат | ❌ не думать | ### Готовые шаблоны **Строгий русский язык:** ``` Ты отвечаешь ТОЛЬКО на русском языке, даже если вопрос на другом языке. Если не знаешь ответа — честно скажи. ``` **Код-ревью:** ``` Проведи ревью кода. Найди: 1) баги, 2) уязвимости, 3) проблемы производительности. Для каждой: строка, суть, исправленный фрагмент. В конце — оценка 1–10. <код> ... ``` **Извлечение данных:** ``` Извлеки все компании и суммы сделок. Верни ТОЛЬКО JSON-массив [{"company": str, "amount_rub": number}] без пояснений. Текст: ... ``` **Анализ договора (V4, контекст 1M):** ``` <документ> ...весь договор... Найди пункты, невыгодные Исполнителю. Для каждого: цитата, риск, новая формулировка. ``` ### Убираем `` из ответа и истории ```python import re answer = re.sub(r".*?", "", text, flags=re.S).strip() ``` В историю диалога клади только `answer`. Ускорение и оптимизация **Две скорости:** - **prefill (pp)**: как быстро модель читает промпт; упирается в вычисления GPU; - **generation (tg)**: как быстро пишет ответ; упирается в пропускную способность памяти. **Оценка потолка скорости генерации:** ``` токенов/с ≈ пропускная способность памяти (ГБ/с) ÷ размер активных весов (ГБ) ``` Пример: RTX 4090 (~1000 ГБ/с) с моделью 14B-Q4 (~9 ГБ) в теории даёт ~110 ток/с, на практике 60–80. Для MoE считаются только **активные** веса, поэтому V4-Flash (13B активных) остаётся быстрой даже частично из RAM. ### Чек-лист ускорения (по убыванию эффекта) ### Ориентировочная скорость генерации > Порядок величин по замерам сообщества (Q4, короткий контекст, вся модель на GPU, если не сказано иное). Твои цифры будут отличаться. Присылай свои замеры через [Issue](https://github.com/justxor/deepseek-local-guide-ru/issues/new?template=benchmark.md). | Железо | R1 8B | R1 14B | R1 32B | R1 70B | V4-Flash / V4.1-Flash | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | CPU, DDR5 2 канала | 8–12 | 4–7 | 2–3 | ~1 | — | | RTX 3060 12 ГБ | 50–60 | 30–35 | ⚠️ | ❌ | ❌ | | RTX 4090 24 ГБ | 110–130 | 70–80 | 35–40 | ⚠️ 3–8 | ⚠️ с 128 ГБ RAM | | RTX 5090 32 ГБ | 150+ | 90–110 | 50–60 | ⚠️ | ⚠️ с 128 ГБ RAM | | Mac M3/M4 Max 64–128 ГБ | 60–80 | 35–45 | 18–25 | 8–12 | V4-Flash IQ3 на 128 ГБ | | DGX Spark 128 ГБ | — | — | — | — | V4-Flash IQ2: **6–7** | | Mac Studio M3 Ultra 256 ГБ | — | — | — | — | V4.1-Flash MLX 2 бит: **~9.5** | 1. ✅ Вся модель на GPU (`ollama ps` → `100% GPU`, в llama.cpp `-ngl 99`). 2. ✅ Квант поменьше (Q4 вместо Q8) почти линейно ускоряет генерацию. 3. ✅ Для MoE держи экспертов в RAM, а остальное на GPU (`-ot ".ffn_.*_exps.=CPU"`). 4. ✅ Flash attention (`-fa on` или `OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1`). 5. ✅ KV-кэш в `q8_0` освобождает VRAM под слои. 6. ✅ Спекулятивное декодирование (драфтер) даёт 1.5–2× на генерации. 7. ✅ Потоки = физические ядра (на Intel только P-ядра). 8. ✅ Больше батч (`-b 2048 -ub 2048`) ускоряет длинные промпты. 9. ✅ Неизменный системный промпт: включается кэш префикса. 10. ✅ Для CPU-инференса важна быстрая RAM (DDR5, заняты все каналы). ### Mac: дать GPU больше памяти ```bash sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb=122880 # пример для Mac со 128 ГБ ``` Настройка сбрасывается после перезагрузки. bge-m3"] E1 --> V[("Векторная база")] end subgraph Ответ["💬 Ответ (каждый вопрос)"] Q["Вопрос"] --> E2["Эмбеддинг"] E2 --> S["Поиск top-k"] V --> S S --> RR["Реранкер"] RR --> P["Промпт + контекст"] P --> M["DeepSeek"] M --> A["Ответ + источники"] end ``` | Компонент | Простой вариант | Продвинутый вариант | |---|---|---| | Эмбеддинги | `bge-m3` в Ollama | `multilingual-e5-large`, `bge-m3` в vLLM | | Векторная база | numpy в памяти | Qdrant, Chroma, pgvector | | Поиск | косинусная близость | гибрид BM25 + векторы | | Реранкер | нет | `bge-reranker-v2-m3` | | Модель | R1 14B | V4-Flash / V4.1-Flash | | Интерфейс | скрипт | Open WebUI Knowledge, AnythingLLM | **Без кода:** Open WebUI → Workspace → Knowledge → загрузи PDF или DOCX, затем в чате введи `#` и выбери базу. **На Python:** [examples/rag_minimal.py](examples/rag_minimal.py) ```bash ollama pull bge-m3 # эмбеддинги, хорошо понимают русский ollama pull deepseek-r1:14b python examples/rag_minimal.py --docs ./my_docs --question "Какой срок оплаты?" ``` **Как сделать RAG точнее:** - эмбеддинги для русского: `bge-m3` или `multilingual-e5-large`; - с V4 и контекстом 1M небольшую базу можно положить в промпт целиком, без RAG. ### Tool calling: модель вызывает твои функции ```python tools = [{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "get_weather", "description": "Погода в городе", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["city"]} } }] resp = client.chat.completions.create(model="deepseek-r1:14b", messages=msgs, tools=tools) print(resp.choices[0].message.tool_calls) ``` Полный цикл «модель → функция → модель»: [examples/tool_calling.py](examples/tool_calling.py). ### Фреймворки | Фреймворк | Подключение | |---|---| | LangChain / LangGraph | `ChatOllama(model="deepseek-r1:14b")` | | LlamaIndex | `Ollama(model="deepseek-r1:14b")` | | CrewAI | `LLM(model="ollama/deepseek-r1:14b")` | | smolagents | `OpenAIServerModel(api_base="http://localhost:11434/v1", ...)` | **Паттерн «планировщик + исполнитель»:** думающая модель один раз раскладывает задачу на шаги, а быстрая (no-think) выполняет их и вызывает инструменты. Получается дешевле и быстрее. 📖 Подробнее: [docs/10-rag-i-agenty.md](docs/10-rag-i-agenty.md) --- ## 🎓 Часть 13. Дообучение (fine-tuning) Дообучение нужно, когда модель должна усвоить **стиль, формат или узкую предметную область**. Если задача в том, чтобы модель знала **факты** из твоих документов, сначала попробуй RAG. **Самый доступный способ:** QLoRA через [Unsloth](https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth) на дистилляте R1. ```mermaid flowchart LR A["📝 Датасет JSONL
500–5000 примеров"] --> B["🔧 Unsloth QLoRA
4-бит, r=16"] B --> C["🧪 Проверка
на отложенных 10%"] C -->|"плохо"| A C -->|"хорошо"| D["📦 Экспорт GGUF
Q4_K_M"] D --> E["🦙 Ollama
ollama create"] ``` | Метод | VRAM для 14B | Качество | Скорость обучения | |---|---|---|---| | Полное дообучение | 200+ ГБ | ★★★★★ | медленно | | LoRA (16 бит) | ~35 ГБ | ★★★★ | средне | | **QLoRA (4 бит)** | **~12–16 ГБ** | ★★★★ | **быстро** | | Модель | VRAM для QLoRA (ориентир) | |---|---| | R1-Distill 1.5B–8B | 6–12 ГБ | | R1-Distill 14B | 12–16 ГБ | | R1-Distill 32B | 24+ ГБ | **План:** 1. Собери 500–5000 примеров «вопрос → идеальный ответ» в JSONL (для reasoning-моделей с рассуждением). 2. Обучи LoRA-адаптер в Unsloth (есть бесплатные ноутбуки для Colab). 3. Экспортируй в GGUF (`model.save_pretrained_gguf(...)`). 4. Подключи в Ollama через Modelfile: `FROM ./my-model-Q4_K_M.gguf`. 📖 Пошагово: [docs/13-fine-tuning.md](docs/13-fine-tuning.md) --- ## 🔥 Часть 14. Топ-30 фишек и приёмов **Память и запуск** 1. **Квант `Q4_K_M` по умолчанию**, `Q5_K_M` при запасе памяти, `Q8_0` — почти без потерь. 2. **Динамические кванты Unsloth (`UD-*`)**: важные слои остаются точными, поэтому V4-Flash в 3 битах влезает в ~110 ГБ. 3. **Эксперты MoE в RAM:** `-ot ".ffn_.*_exps.=CPU"` позволяет запустить 284B-модель на одной GPU. 4. **Явно увеличь контекст в Ollama:** `OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768`, стандартного не хватает для документов. 5. **Сожми KV-кэш:** `OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0` + `OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1`. 6. **`OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1`** убирает задержку перед первым ответом. 7. **Mac:** `sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb=…` открывает GPU больше памяти. 8. **Модели на другой диск:** `OLLAMA_MODELS=D:\ollama` (они занимают десятки гигабайт). **Качество** 9. **R1: temperature 0.6**, а не 0. Иначе модель зацикливается. 10. **V4: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0.** 11. **R1:** инструкции в сообщении пользователя, системный промпт минимальный. 12. **Математика:** «ответ помести в `\boxed{}`». 13. **Отключай размышления там, где они не нужны:** `/set nothink`, `"think": false`, `--reasoning off`. 14. **`reasoning_effort: "max"`** у V4 для самых сложных задач (нужен большой контекст). 15. **Вырезай `` из истории диалога.** 16. **JSON Schema в `format`** даёт гарантированно валидный JSON. 17. **Для русского бери 14B+**, маленькие дистилляты срываются на английский и китайский. 18. **Длинный документ в начало промпта, вопрос в конец.** **Скорость** 19. **Спекулятивное декодирование** (DSpark для V4-Flash): 1.5–2×. 20. **`-ngl 99`**: каждый слой в RAM сильно замедляет. 21. **Потоки = физические ядра**, а не логические. 22. **`--mlock`**, если система «свопает» модель. 23. **vLLM или SGLang** для нескольких пользователей: continuous batching даёт кратный прирост. 24. **Не меняй системный промпт между запросами**, тогда работает кэш префикса. **Интеграции** 25. **Любой клиент OpenAI** работает с локальной моделью через `base_url`. 26. **Continue или Cline в VS Code** + DeepSeek дают бесплатного приватного Copilot. 27. **Open WebUI + Knowledge** — RAG без единой строчки кода. 28. **Один код для облака и локалки:** меняется только `base_url`. 29. **`docker compose up -d`** поднимает весь стек одной командой. 30. **Никогда не открывай порт 11434 в интернет**: у API Ollama нет пароля. --- ## 🛠 Часть 15. FAQ
Можно ли запустить DeepSeek без видеокарты? Да. Ollama, LM Studio и llama.cpp работают на процессоре. Модели 1.5B–8B на современном CPU выдают 5–15 токенов/с. Для V4-Flash без GPU нужно 128+ ГБ RAM и терпение.
Сколько оперативной памяти нужно для DeepSeek? Для `deepseek-r1:8b` хватит 8 ГБ RAM/VRAM, для `14b` нужно 12–16 ГБ, для `32b` 24 ГБ, для `70b` 48 ГБ, для V4-Flash от ~110 ГБ. Точный расчёт — в [части 4](#-часть-4-железо-сколько-нужно-памяти).
Данные уходят в Китай, если запускать DeepSeek локально? Нет. Локальная модель — это файл с весами, и сам по себе он ничего не отправляет. В сеть программа выходит только при скачивании модели. Для полной изоляции скачай модель заранее и работай без интернета. Теги `:cloud`, сайт chat.deepseek.com и облачный API — уже не локальный запуск.
Можно ли использовать DeepSeek в коммерческих проектах? Веса DeepSeek V3, R1 и V4 опубликованы под лицензией MIT, которая разрешает коммерческое использование. Дистилляты наследуют лицензию базовой модели: Qwen — Apache 2.0, Llama — Llama Community License. Всегда проверяй карточку модели. Это не юридическая консультация.
Что лучше: DeepSeek R1 или V4? V4 — более новое и сильное поколение: гибридный режим (думает или отвечает сразу) и контекст 1M токенов. Но на домашнем ПК реалистичны только дистилляты R1, потому что V4-Flash требует ~110+ ГБ памяти.
Чем Ollama отличается от llama.cpp и LM Studio? Ollama — удобная обёртка с каталогом моделей и API, которая подходит большинству. LM Studio — то же самое, но с графическим интерфейсом. llama.cpp — сам движок: максимум настроек и самая ранняя поддержка новых моделей (например, V4-Flash GGUF).
Почему DeepSeek в Ollama такой медленный? Чаще всего модель не поместилась в видеопамять и частично работает с CPU. Проверь `ollama ps`, уменьши контекст, возьми модель меньше или квант ниже. Включи flash attention.
Как сделать, чтобы DeepSeek отвечал только на русском? Возьми модель 14B+, добавь системный промпт «Отвечай только на русском» и повторяй это в сообщении. Для постоянного эффекта создай свой Modelfile ([часть 5](#-часть-5-ollama--установка-и-настройка)).
Как отключить «размышления» DeepSeek? В Ollama — `/set nothink` или `"think": false` в API. В llama.cpp — `--reasoning off`. В Open WebUI — переключатель в настройках модели.
DeepSeek цензурирует ответы и локально? Ограничения на ряд тем зашиты в веса модели, поэтому при локальном запуске они сохраняются. Но системный промпт, параметры и дообучение здесь полностью под твоим контролем.
--- ## 📖 Часть 17. Глоссарий | Термин | Что значит | |---|---| | **LLM** | Большая языковая модель | | **Параметры (B)** | Число весов модели, B = миллиард | | **MoE** | Смесь экспертов: на токен работает лишь часть модели | | **Активные параметры** | Сколько весов реально считается на каждом токене | | **Квантизация** | Сжатие весов до меньшего числа бит | | **GGUF** | Формат файлов модели для llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio | | **Safetensors** | Формат весов на Hugging Face для vLLM и Transformers | | **Контекст** | Сколько токенов модель «видит» за раз | | **KV-кэш** | Память, где хранится обработанный контекст | | **Токен** | Кусочек текста (~3–4 символа для русского) | | **VRAM** | Память видеокарты | | **Unified memory** | Общая память CPU и GPU у Apple Silicon | | **Offload** | Перенос части модели с GPU в RAM | | **Prefill / pp** | Обработка входного промпта | | **Generation / tg** | Генерация ответа | | **Дистиллят** | Маленькая модель, обученная на ответах большой | | **Reasoning / thinking** | Режим размышлений перед ответом | | **RAG** | Ответы с опорой на найденные документы | | **Эмбеддинг** | Вектор, описывающий смысл текста | | **Tool calling** | Модель вызывает внешние функции | | **LoRA / QLoRA** | Дешёвое дообучение небольшими адаптерами | | **Tensor parallel** | Разделение модели между несколькими GPU | | **Спекулятивное декодирование** | Маленькая модель угадывает токены, большая проверяет | --- ## 🗂 Часть 18. # TokenForge **Less Context. More Coding.** TokenForge is an open-source context optimization engine designed to reduce token consumption, preserve session memory, and improve efficiency across AI-powered coding workflows. 酷安

基于 Tauri 2、Vue 3 和 Rust 的非官方酷安桌面客户端。

> [!IMPORTANT] > 本项目是社区维护的非官方客户端，与酷安官方及深圳酷安网络科技有限公司无隶属、授权或合作关系。酷安名称、Logo 和相关商标归其权利人所有。 ## 📥 下载与安装 请前往 [👉 GitHub Releases](https://github.com/coolapk-desktop/coolapk-desktop/releases) 获取各平台的最新版本程序包： | 操作系统 | 文件格式 | 推荐安装包 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Windows 安装版** | `.exe` | `coolapk-desktop_x.x.x_x64-setup.exe` (x64) / `arm64-setup.exe` (ARM64) | | **Windows 单文件版** | `.exe` | `coolapk-desktop_x.x.x_x64-portable.exe` (x64) / `arm64-portable.exe` (ARM64) | | **macOS** | `.dmg` / `.app` | `coolapk-desktop_x.x.x_aarch64.dmg` (Apple 芯片) / `x64.dmg` (Intel 芯片) | | **Linux** | `.AppImage` / `.deb` / `.rpm` | `coolapk-desktop_x.x.x_amd64.AppImage` / `.deb` / `.rpm` | | **Android** | `.apk` / `.aab` | `coolapk-vx.y.z-android-arm64.apk` / `coolapk-vx.y.z-android-arm64.aab` | | **iPhone / iPad** | `.ipa` | `coolapk-vx.y.z-ios-arm64-unsigned.ipa`（未签名，需自行签名安装） | > 💡 **提示**：构建产物均由 GitHub Actions 自动化流程在云端打包。Windows 单文件版无需解压或安装，系统需已有 WebView2 Runtime。iOS IPA 为未签名设备包，不能直接安装到普通 iPhone/iPad，需要使用 AltStore、SideStore、Sideloadly 或自己的 Apple 证书完成签名。 ## 界面预览 ![界面预览 1](docs/screenshots/首页.png) ## Star 走势 ## 贡献者 [![贡献者](https://contrib.rocks/image?repo=coolapk-desktop/coolapk-desktop)](https://github.com/coolapk-desktop/coolapk-desktop/graphs/contributors) ## 下载量统计图 [![下载量统计图](https://release-monitor.com/chart/coolapk-desktop/coolapk-desktop.svg?stable=5)](https://release-monitor.com/#/coolapk-desktop/coolapk-desktop) ## 功能 - **首页信息流**：推荐、热榜、快讯、酷图、二手、数码、评测等频道一应俱全 - **动态浏览**：图文详情、评论楼中楼、热门爆评、点赞、收藏、转发查看，体验顺畅 - **浏览历史**：时间轴轨迹记录，支持动态、用户、话题与应用分类即时筛选及右侧常逛侧边栏 - **关注与粉丝**：双列响应式布局，支持查看已关注酷友及粉丝列表、实时动态与全量自动翻页 - **搜索直达**：全站综合搜索涵盖应用、游戏、用户、话题与动态帖子 - **收藏管理**：集成云端收藏与收藏单合集，支持全屏满幅平铺浏览 - **广场中心**：涵盖话题广场、评测区、应用中心与游戏中心 - **私信聊天**：支持文字与图片消息，支持多账号快速切换 - **账号能力**：官方授权或 Cookie 登录（详见 [手动抓取与导入 Cookie 指南](docs/cookie-guide.md)），多账户本地保存与一键切账号 - **个性化与布局**：全屏无边距满幅平铺、深浅色主题、侧边栏折叠与默认启动页设置 - **跨平台**：Windows、macOS、Linux 原生桌面应用，以及 Android、iOS 移动端应用 部分功能依赖酷安服务端接口，可能因官方调整、账号权限或风控策略而临时失效。 ## 隐私与网络访问 - 项目不内置个人 Cookie、账号 Token、统计 SDK 或遥测服务。 - 登录凭据由用户手动输入，只保存在本地应用数据目录的账户库中，不写入仓库。 - 客户端标识在每次启动时临时生成，不使用开发者或用户的固定设备指纹。 - 应用会直接访问 `api.coolapk.com`、酷安图片/静态资源域名；不会向第三方字体或图标 CDN 发起请求。 - 游客首次使用或点击“自动生成并使用”时，会向数盟 `auni.telecome.cn` 请求 DUID，仅发送合成设备标识，不发送酷安 Cookie 或真实硬件标识。游客 DUID 在本机缓存复用；登录后默认停用，用户可在设备信息设置中主动生成并启用本次登录使用的 DUID。 - 请勿在 Issue、日志或截图中提交真实 Cookie、私信和其他个人数据。 - 诊断日志默认保存在本机。反馈时可在“设置 → 诊断日志”检查并导出需要提供的内容，再自行决定是否将文件附加到 GitHub Issue；提交前请确认日志中不含账号凭据或个人信息。旧版客户端生成的诊断日志附件仍可在该页面读取。 详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 ## 开发环境 - Node.js 22 或更高版本 - Rust stable - 各平台的 [Tauri 2 系统依赖](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/) ```bash git clone https://github.com/coolapk-desktop/coolapk-desktop.git cd coolapk-desktop npm ci npm run tauri dev ``` 生产构建可按当前平台选择产物格式： ```bash # Windows：构建 NSIS 安装包；原始 release 可执行文件即单文件版 npm run tauri build -- --bundles nsis ./scripts/prepare-windows-portable.ps1 -Architecture x64 # Linux npm run tauri build -- --bundles appimage,deb,rpm # macOS npm run tauri build -- --bundles app,dmg ``` ### Android APK Android 构建需要 JDK 17+、Android SDK、Platform Tools、Build Tools 和 NDK (Side by side)。Windows 下构建脚本会自动读取 `JAVA_HOME`、`ANDROID_HOME`、`NDK_HOME`，也能识别默认 Android SDK 和本项目使用的 Android OpenJDK 安装位置。 ```bash # 首次生成 Android 工程（生成目录不会提交到 Git） npm run android:init # 默认构建 ARM64 debug APK，适用于大多数真机 npm run android:build # 自定义目标，例如生成全部架构的 debug APK npm run android:build -- --debug --apk ``` APK 输出到 `src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/`。连接设备后可用 `adb install -r ` 安装。正式分发前还需配置 Android 签名；Google Play 应优先构建并上传 AAB。 Tag 发布时，GitHub Actions 会构建签名的 ARM64 release APK 和 AAB，并上传到同一个 GitHub Release。仓库需要配置以下 Actions Secrets： - `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`：上传密钥 `.jks` 文件的 Base64 内容 - `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`：密钥库密码 - `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`：密钥别名 - `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD`：密钥密码 安装包位于 `src-tauri/target/release/bundle/`。GitHub Actions 会提供： - Windows x64：NSIS 安装包 `-setup.exe`、单文件便携版 `x64-portable.exe` - Windows ARM64：NSIS 安装包 `-setup.exe`、单文件便携版 `arm64-portable.exe` - Linux x64：AppImage 免安装版 `.AppImage`、Debian 安装包 `.deb`、RPM 安装包 `.rpm` - macOS Apple 芯片：磁盘映像 `.dmg`、应用包 `.app` - macOS Intel：磁盘映像 `.dmg`、应用包 `.app` - Android ARM64：Release APK `.apk`、Google Play 发布包 `.aab` - iOS ARM64：未签名 IPA `.ipa`（供第三方工具或用户自行签名） ### iOS IPA iOS 构建必须在 macOS 上完成，并需要完整的 Xcode、CocoaPods 和 Rust iOS 目标。首次构建前，在 macOS 上执行： ```bash # 安装 CocoaPods（已安装可跳过） brew install cocoapods # 安装 Rust iOS 目标 rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios aarch64-apple-ios-sim x86_64-apple-ios # 首次生成 iOS 工程 npm run tauri -- ios init # 使用 Xcode 打开并调试 npm run tauri -- ios dev --open # 构建设备版未签名 IPA npm run tauri -- ios build --target aarch64 --no-sign --ci ``` GitHub Actions 会在推送 `v*` 版本标签时自动生成 ARM64 未签名 IPA，并上传到对应的 GitHub Release。该 IPA 不包含 Apple 开发者签名，安装到真机前需要使用 AltStore、SideStore、Sideloadly 或自己的证书重新签名；它不是可直接提交 App Store 的发行包。 ## 自动发布 推送以 `v` 开头的版本标签后，GitHub Actions 会自动构建全部平台，并创建公开的 GitHub Release，上传上述安装包。普通的 `main` 分支推送和 Pull Request 只执行构建检查，不会发布版本。 发布前只需更新 `src/constants/version.ts` 并创建对应标签，GitHub Actions 会从标签自动同步版本号到全部构建文件： ```bash npm run version:set -- 1.2.3 npm run build git tag v1.2.3 git push origin main v1.2.3 ``` Windows 客户端会自动识别当前运行方式：安装版下载同架构的 `-setup.exe` 静默升级，单文件版下载同架构的 `-portable.exe`，退出后原位替换并重启。两种更新包都必须与 Release 标签版本一致，避免装错版本。 ## 常用检查 ```bash npm run build npm audit cd src-tauri cargo test cargo check ``` ## 项目结构 ```text src/ Vue 3 / TypeScript 前端 api/coolapk.ts Tauri 命令调用封装 utils/coolapkEmoji.ts 酷安表情映射 src-tauri/ Rust / Tauri 桌面端 src/coolapk/auth.rs Token V3 兼容签名 src/coolapk/client.rs API、图片和会话请求 src/coolapk/commands.rs Tauri commands src/coolapk/api_tests.rs 接口可用性探测测试 docs/screenshots/ 界面预览截图 .github/workflows/build.yml 跨平台构建流程 ``` ## 登录说明 公开浏览功能（查看动态、评论、图文等）无需登录即可使用。若需发帖、评论、点赞、私信等互动操作，可在客户端右上角唤起登录弹窗： 1. **官方授权登录（推荐）**： - 客户端内置调起酷安官方授权登录页面（`account.coolapk.com`），支持微信扫码与手机短信验证码登录，登录成功后自动同步会话与多账号库。 2. **手动 Cookie 导入（备用）**： - 若系统未安装完整 WebView2 或官方窗口授权异常，可展开弹窗底部的「备用登录选项」，通过浏览器抓取 Cookie 凭据进行导入。 - 详细提取与配置步骤请参阅：👉 **[📖 手动抓取与导入 Cookie 指南](docs/cookie-guide.md)**（包含保留日志、定位主站请求与凭据有效性校验步骤）。 > ⚠️ **凭据安全提示**：Cookie 包含账号的完整操作权限。客户端仅将其安全持久化在本地应用数据目录中，绝不写入代码仓库或上传任何第三方服务器。请妥善保管，切勿在公开 Issue、日志或聊天截图中泄露真实 Cookie。 ## 贡献 欢迎提交 Issue 和 Pull Request。提交前请运行前端构建、Rust 测试，并确保测试数据不包含真实账号、Cookie、设备标识或私信内容。 ## 许可证 代码采用 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)。第三方品牌、Logo、表情及服务端内容不包含在 MIT 授权范围内，详见 [第三方声明](NOTICE.md)。

# EAC design world **让创作，自成世界。** DeepSeek Harness 的本地视频制作与设计工作室 [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world?include_prereleases&style=for-the-badge&color=227b70)](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0-227b70?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22%2B-43853d?style=for-the-badge&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world?style=for-the-badge&color=d77b66)](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world/stargazers) [下载发布包](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world/releases) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [功能一览](#功能一览) · [设计与架构](#设计与架构) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world/issues)
**把模板、素材、剪辑和设计工程连在一起，让 AI 与你共同完成一件可预览、可修订、可导出的作品。** EAC design world 为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供原生创作模式、模板选择和右侧作品画布，同时拥有可独立运行的本地工作台。视频录制、配音、配乐、字幕、编码与检查产生真实文件；网站、幻灯片、SVG 和文档保留源文件及版本历史。 当前版本为 **v0.3.0 开发预览版**。本版包含独立的插件维护导航、签名更新与回滚、编辑草稿恢复和预览安全修复，详见 [发布说明](docs/release-v0.3.0.md)。Windows 上的录屏、语音、转录和渲染流程已执行测试；其他平台的桌面录制与本地语音未实现。模板数量代表可检索内容，不代表每个模板均可离线直接渲染。


按创作类型推荐模板，保留真实封面与可移除的选择标签。

## 目录 | 开始使用 | 创作能力 | 开发与来源 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | [下载与安装](#下载与安装)
[环境要求](#环境要求)
[快速开始](#快速开始) | [功能一览](#功能一览)
[设计内容库](#设计内容库)
[AI 与 MCP](#ai-与-mcp) | [设计与架构](#设计与架构)
[开发与验证](#开发与验证)
[许可证与致谢](#许可证与致谢) | ## 功能一览 | 你想完成的工作 | 插件提供的能力 | | --- | --- | | 从对话开始创作 | 正常、剪辑、Design 三种模式；模板区独立铺开，选择状态不覆盖正文；重复点击或标签上的 × 可取消 | | 找到合适的视觉风格 | 152 套设计体系与 517 个 OpenDesign 模板条目，另有原有 17 个视频选项；按类型搜索、分类和分页 | | 录下真实产品 | Edge 网页操作录制；Windows 桌面录制；原素材不被改写 | | 编排实际镜头 | 多轨时间线，调整开始时间、素材入点、时长、音量和轨道；带修订号保存 | | 处理语音与字幕 | 本地语音转录、去停顿初稿、SRT、时间线字幕与 ASS 烧录；转录需自行准备本地模型 | | 完成声音与编码 | Windows SAPI 旁白、本地确定性器乐、源音轨混音、H.264 输出与技术检查 | | 制作图形动效 | `renderAt(t)` / `__seek(t)`、CSS 动画和 GSAP 时间线的确定性驱动与抽帧审查；可选接入 Motion Web 交互案例和 Onetake 函数库 | | 创建网站和演示稿 | HTML、SVG、Markdown 编辑、隔离预览、不可变修订与源文件下载 | | 检查与导出作品 | Harness 原生右侧作品画布、HTML 幻灯片分页、PDF / PNG / PPTX 整页图像导出 | | 维护插件 | 顶部导航中的独立维护中心：运行/安装版本、签名更新、本地更新、备份回滚、宿主热重载、公告与已读记录 | ### 设计内容库 从 [OpenDesign](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design) 导入并建立本地索引的 **865 项内容**： | 内容 | 数量 | | --- | ---: | | 设计体系 | 152 | | 模板条目 | 517 | | 创作技能 | 169 | | 基础组件 | 13 | | 场景 | 14 | 517 个模板条目包含 188 个示例、115 个设计模板、63 个视频模板、45 个图片模板、58 个视频提示词和 48 个图片提示词。部分来自同一视觉主题的不同上游目录，保留独立条目与来源。**205 项需要外部生成服务**；模板中的素材占位符或 HyperFrames 子合成依赖会单独标示。

### 可选动效来源：Motion Web / Onetake 支持从已取得的本地仓库导入 [motion-web](https://github.com/feitangyuan/motion-web) 的 7 个交互案例及制作指南，以及 [onetake](https://github.com/feitangyuan/onetake) 的 OM 动效函数库与制作指南。模板统一进入搜索、源码读取和隔离预览；Onetake 示例可逐帧导出，Motion Web 实时页面可录制为视频。 ```powershell npm run motion:import -- --motion-web "D:\Sources\motion-web" --onetake "D:\Sources\onetake" --noncommercial npm run motion:verify ``` 两者保留各自非商业许可，不进入公共 Git 或 Release 包；商业使用需相应授权。已取得授权的用途用 `--licensed` 记录。详见 [接入、使用与验证说明](docs/motion-libraries.md)。 ## 下载与安装 从 [Releases](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world/releases) 下载同一版本的文件： | 文件 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `eac-design-world-v0.3.0-plugin.zip` | 插件源码、预构建 Web UI、模板源码、设计体系、封面、安装脚本及许可说明；不包含 Node 依赖 | | `eac-design-world-v0.3.0-media.zip` | 可选大媒体包：MG 原始预览视频、字体、渲染素材及宣传片素材 | | `eac-design-world-v0.3.0-update.zip` | 维护中心使用的签名本地更新包，解压后选择其中 `manifest.json` | | `SHA256SUMS.txt` | 发布产物的 SHA-256 校验值 | | GitHub 自动生成的 Source code | 与仓库提交对应的源码快照，不含预构建 `dist` 和可选大媒体 | 两个 ZIP 使用相同的 `eac-design-world/` 根目录。先解压插件包，再将媒体包合并解压到同一位置。保留原目录结构，不要把所有文件平铺到一个目录。 > 媒体包不含 FFmpeg、Node、Python、Whisper 模型或 `node_modules`，也不再分发 Alibaba PuHuiTi 3 / Alimama ShuHeiTi 字体文件（需从官方来源自行获取）。未安装媒体包时，一些经典动效渲染素材不可用，设计库及设计编辑仍可使用。工作台预览优先展示当前项目成片，没有成片时展示所选模板。 ### 环境要求 - **Node.js 22 或更新版本**，附带 npm。 - 视频剪辑与导出需要 **FFmpeg / FFprobe**，并位于 `PATH`。 - 浏览器录制、HTML 逐帧渲染和文档导出默认使用 **Microsoft Edge**；可通过 `EAC_BROWSER` 指定兼容 Chromium 可执行文件。 - Harness 插件模式要求宿主提供 conversation、settings 和 right-sidebar 槽位；也可独立打开本地工作台。 - 桌面录制与 SAPI 旁白目前仅支持 Windows。 - 可选转录：Python、`faster-whisper` 及已下载到本地的兼容模型目录。通过 `EAC_WHISPER_MODEL_PATH` 指定模型；运行时不会替你下载模型。 ## 快速开始 ### 方式一：使用发布包 在已解压的 `eac-design-world` 目录打开 PowerShell： ```powershell npm ci --omit=dev npm run doctor node scripts/install-harness.mjs --dry-run node scripts/install-harness.mjs ``` 重新加载 Harness 后，即可在输入框工具栏选择剪辑或 Design 模式，在设置中进入 EAC 工作台。安装器会备份宿主配置，只增加当前插件的包链接和组合包选择，不覆盖其他插件。 自定义宿主 profile： ```powershell node scripts/install-harness.mjs --profile "D:\YourHarnessProfile" --dry-run node scripts/install-harness.mjs --profile "D:\YourHarnessProfile" ``` 卸载可使用安装器返回的备份路径： ```powershell node scripts/install-harness.mjs --uninstall "<安装器返回的备份目录>" ``` ### 方式二：独立工作台 ```powershell npm ci --omit=dev npm start ``` 打开 。如果 Harness 已经启动插件服务，可直接使用它，不要再启动第二份监听同一端口的服务。端口可通过 `EAC_PORT` 更改，但 Harness 客户端入口默认连接 4173。 ### 方式三：从源码构建 ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-design-world.git cd EAC-design-world npm ci npm run build npm start ``` 源码不保存大媒体文件。需要完整经典视频模板素材时，将同一版本媒体包中的目录合并到源码根目录。 ### 常用操作 1. 选择剪辑模式或 Design 模式，再选择模板；选择显示为输入框内的缩略图标签，正文保留给你的创作说明。 2. 切换网站、动效、幻灯片、文档、图片类型，模板推荐随之变化；重复点选中卡片或点标签 × 取消。 3. 在工作台创建项目、导入素材、编辑时间线或设计文件，再保存新版本。 4. 点击画布按钮，在 Harness 右侧预览设计作品与实际视频输出；工作台的固定宣传片预览与项目交付文件分开。 5. 完成任务后检查真实输出、音量与抽帧。机器质检不能替代构图、文字、品牌和叙事审查。 ## AI 与 MCP Harness 原生工具与标准 MCP 服务共用本地后端。工具包括状态查询、模板搜索与读取、素材导入、时间线修订、制作任务、设计项目和成品保存。 主要工具：`library_list`、`library_read`、`project_create`、`timeline_update`、`job_submit`、`job_status`、`design_project_create`、`design_artifact_save`。Harness 内工具名添加 `eac_` 前缀。 先启动本地服务，再配置支持 MCP 的客户端： ```json { "mcpServers": { "eac-design-world": { "command": "node", "args": ["D:/Apps/eac-design-world/src/mcp.mjs"], "env": { "EAC_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:4173" } } } } ``` 把示例路径换成你的安装目录。长任务返回 job ID，可轮询结果、查看错误和真实文件；模板或模式选择本身不代表已生成作品。 ## 设计与架构 ```text Harness 对话 / 设置 / 原生右侧画布 │ plugin/client.js + host.mjs │ 本地 HTTP 服务 / MCP │ 项目存储 · 修订 · 任务队列 ┌────┴────┐ FFmpeg / Playwright 设计成品存储 录制、剪辑、混音 HTML / SVG / MD 编码、字幕、抽帧 预览、历史、导出 ``` - [架构说明](docs/architecture.md) - [OpenDesign 融合与能力边界](docs/open-design-integration.md) - [字体来源与安装](docs/fonts.md) - [AI 制作工作流](docs/harness-ai-workflow.md) - [插件更新、热重载与公告维护](docs/maintenance.md) - [第三方许可与来源](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) ### 当前边界 - 未嵌入 OpenDesign 全部 Electron 基础设施、HyperFrames 子合成引擎、插件市场或远程生成供应商。 - HTML 幻灯片可预览和导出；**PPTX 导出是整页图像**，不提供逐元素 PowerPoint 编辑。原 HTML 保留可编辑内容。 - 任意已有二进制 PPTX 的解析编辑、系统音频录制和语义艺术评分尚未实现。 - SAPI 声线取决于系统安装；本地器乐不是商业作曲模型。转录结果与初剪建议需要复核。 - 一些原始 MG 模板依赖 Blender 预渲染帧或未分发字体；可用性由实际依赖决定。 ## 开发与验证 ```powershell npm ci npm run build npm test node scripts/verify-picker-layout.mjs node scripts/verify-open-design.mjs ``` 完整媒体测试需要 FFmpeg、Edge、Windows SAPI 及本地转录依赖；缺少依赖时请看具体错误或跳过说明，不把纯构建成功当成视频流程已通过。交互验收使用隔离数据目录与独立端口，不覆盖用户项目。 项目目录： ```text plugin/ Harness 客户端与宿主入口 src/ 项目、任务队列、媒体引擎、设计存储与 MCP ui/ React 工作台、模板选择、编辑器与画布 public/ 插件头像、真实模板封面、可选宣传片 vendor/ 第三方模板源码、设计体系与许可 scripts/ 安装、构建发布包、诊断与交互验证 tests/ 单元、媒体与集成测试 ``` ## 许可证与致谢 项目自有代码采用 [AGPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE)。第三方代码、模板、字体和媒体保留各自条款，不因放入本仓库而变更许可证。头像 Logo 和宣传片由项目维护者提供，不单独授予其图像内容的再许可。 感谢 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)、[EAC-Desktop](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/EAC-Desktop)、[OpenDesign](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design)、[15 Motion Design Styles](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/mg-styles-15) 及其内容贡献者，以及 FFmpeg、Playwright、GSAP、React 和相关开源依赖。 CC-BY 条目的作者与来源记录在本地 catalog 中。可选 PolyForm Noncommercial 库不纳入发布包；两项没有明确再分发许可的社交帖子来源内容不纳入公开分发。详情见 [Third Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 ---
