items.readme:
The most accurate open-source SVG maps of Tunisia

Country · 7 economic regions · 5 districts · 24 governorates · 279 delegations · 2,083 imadas
5 levels of detail · 8 visual modes · SVG · GeoJSON · TopoJSON · العربية · Français · English

[![CI](https://github.com/Alaa-Taieb/map-tunisia/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Alaa-Taieb/map-tunisia/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![OpenStreetMap data](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenStreetMap-2026--10--16-7ebc6f?logo=openstreetmap&logoColor=white)](docs/accuracy.md) [![Delegations](https://img.shields.io/badge/delegations-279%20%2F%20279-0e7490)](docs/reference.md#delegations) [![Gaps & overlaps](https://img.shields.io/badge/gaps%20%26%20overlaps-0-2e7d32)](docs/accuracy.md) [![Code: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![Data: ODbL](https://img.shields.io/badge/data-ODbL%201.0-orange)](LICENSE-DATA.md) **[🧭 Live explorer](https://alaa-taieb.github.io/map-tunisia/)** · **[⬇️ Download](#-download)** · **[⚡ Quick start](#-quick-start)** · **[📚 Docs](docs/README.md)** · **[✅ Accuracy report](docs/accuracy.md)**
--- ## Why Map Tunisia? Most Tunisia SVGs online are hand-traced, outdated, missing islands, or stop at the 24 governorates. Map Tunisia is built from **OpenStreetMap**, the most precise open source of Tunisian boundaries, and cross-checked against official INS and ISIE lists. The result is a complete, exactly nested set of maps that you can drop into any project.
### 🎯 Accurate - Real coastline at full precision, with **every island**: Djerba, Kerkennah, La Galite, Zembra, Kuriat… - **0 km² of gaps or overlaps**: every level is cut from one planar topology - Land area within **0.08 %** of the CIA World Factbook - **[Every correction](docs/accuracy.md)** to the raw data is documented with its source ### 🧩 Complete - **6 nested partitions**, down to the 2,083 *imadas* - **All 279 delegations** of the 2024 census, including the 14 created since 2014, which no other open dataset has - The **2023 districts** (Decree 2023-589) and the **7 economic regions** - **2014 & 2024 census population** built in ### 🛠️ Ready to use - **8 modes**: plain, outline, light, dark, Latin labels, Arabic labels, nested borders, interactive - **5 levels of detail**, from 1 m precision to 17 KB icons - Semantic ids (**ISO 3166-2**, **INS codes**) and `data-*` attributes in 3 languages - GeoJSON + TopoJSON + CSV, a **lon/lat → SVG** helper, and an explorer
## 🖼️ Gallery **Six partitions, exactly nested** **Eight modes** **Five levels of detail** (Djerba, at the same zoom)
More examples: labelled maps in both scripts, dark delegations, nested sectors

## ⚡ Quick start **1. Use a file directly.** Every SVG scales to any size: ```html ``` **2. Inline it and style it with CSS.** Every shape has an `id` and `data-*` attributes: ```css #TN-61 { fill: #ffb703; } /* Sfax, by ISO 3166-2 code */ .unit[data-region="sud-ouest"] { fill: #8ecae6; } /* a whole economic region */ .unit:hover { fill: #e63946; } ``` **3. Add behaviour with a few lines of JavaScript:** ```js document.querySelectorAll('.map-tunisia .unit').forEach((el) => el.addEventListener('click', () => alert(`${el.dataset.nameFr} · ${el.dataset.nameAr} — ${Number(el.dataset.population2024).toLocaleString()} inhabitants`))); ``` **4. Place your own points.** All SVGs share one frame (UTM 32N, 1 unit = 1 km): ```js import { project } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Alaa-Taieb/map-tunisia@main/src/projection.js'; const [x, y] = project([10.7600, 34.7406]); // Sfax → SVG coordinates svg.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', ``); ``` **More recipes** for React, D3 + TopoJSON, Leaflet, MapLibre, Python (GeoPandas, Plotly), R, QGIS, Figma, print and laser cutting are in the **[usage guide](docs/usage.md)**. ## ⬇️ Download Every file lives in [`dist/`](dist/) and follows one naming scheme: ```text dist/svg//tunisia---.svg 140 SVG maps dist/geojson/tunisia--.geojson WGS84, with all attributes dist/topojson/tunisia--.topojson WGS84, shared borders dist/data/.csv | .json names, codes, populations, areas, label points ``` | Popular file | Size | | --- | ---: | | [Governorates, labelled](dist/svg/governorates/tunisia-governorates-medium-labeled.svg) · [Arabic](dist/svg/governorates/tunisia-governorates-medium-labeled-ar.svg) | 135 KB | | [Governorates, interactive](dist/svg/governorates/tunisia-governorates-medium-interactive.svg) | 135 KB | | [Delegations, light](dist/svg/delegations/tunisia-delegations-medium-light.svg) | 446 KB | | [Sectors (imadas), nested](dist/svg/sectors/tunisia-sectors-medium-nested.svg) | 1.8 MB | | [Country outline, for icons](dist/svg/country/tunisia-country-tiny-plain.svg) | 4 KB | | [Governorates TopoJSON](dist/topojson/tunisia-governorates-medium.topojson) · [GeoJSON](dist/geojson/tunisia-governorates-medium.geojson) | 105 KB · 306 KB | Browse every combination in the **[file catalog](docs/catalog.md)** or the **[live explorer](https://alaa-taieb.github.io/map-tunisia/)**, or grab everything with **[Download ZIP](https://github.com/Alaa-Taieb/map-tunisia/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)**. For JavaScript projects: `npm install github:Alaa-Taieb/map-tunisia`, then `import { svgPath, project } from 'map-tunisia'` ([API](docs/usage.md#13-the-npm-helper)). ## 📦 What's inside ### Partitions | Partition | Units | | Description | | --- | ---: | --- | --- | | `country` | 1 | تونس | National outline with every island | | `regions` | 7 | الأقاليم الاقتصادية | INS economic regions: Grand Tunis, Nord-Est, Nord-Ouest, Centre-Est, Centre-Ouest, Sud-Est, Sud-Ouest | | `districts` | 5 | الأقاليم | The *aqalim* of Decree 2023-589 (National Council of Regions and Districts) | | `governorates` | 24 | الولايات | The *wilayas*, with ids `TN-11` … `TN-83` (ISO 3166-2) | | `delegations` | 279 | المعتمديات | The *mutamadiyat*, INS 2024 nomenclature | | `sectors` | 2,083 | العمادات | The *imadas*, the finest administrative level | ### Levels of detail | Level | Tolerance | Use it for | Governorates file | | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | | `full` | none (OSM precision) | GIS, print, deep zoom | 1.3 MB | | `high` | ≈ 20 m | posters, zoomable maps | 390 KB | | `medium` | ≈ 100 m | **websites, dashboards, slides** | 135 KB | | `low` | ≈ 500 m | small embeds, mobile | 37 KB | | `tiny` | ≈ 2.5 km | icons, thumbnails | 17 KB | ### Modes | Mode | | Mode | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `plain` | neutral, ready for your CSS | `labeled` | names in Latin script, callouts where crowded | | `outline` | strokes only: print, laser, overlays | `labeled-ar` | names in Arabic, right-to-left | | `light` | colourful, neighbours never share a colour | `nested` | higher-level borders drawn heavier | | `dark` | for dark UIs | `interactive` | hover + tooltips, no JavaScript | Details and guidance: **[partitions, levels & modes](docs/partitions-levels-modes.md)** · every id and attribute: **[data dictionary](docs/data-dictionary.md)**. ## ✅ Accuracy Map Tunisia starts from OpenStreetMap and fixes what raw OSM gets wrong. Everything is reproducible and documented in the **[accuracy report](docs/accuracy.md)**, regenerated with every build. | | Raw OpenStreetMap | Map Tunisia | | --- | --- | --- | | Delegations | 264 + a stale duplicate (2014 nomenclature) | **279**, matching the INS 2024 list code by code | | Nesting | levels drawn independently; lakes missing from delegations | **one planar topology**: 0 gaps, 0 overlaps | | Kébili and Jendouba | 10 sectors in the wrong delegation | reassigned, checked against INS codes and ISIE maps | | Names | rotated or duplicated names, typos, invisible characters | 24 names corrected; Unicode normalised | | Country polygon | includes the 12-NM territorial sea | land only, following the coastline | | Islets | 63 mapped only as coastline | included | How it works: all boundaries are noded into one set of faces, conflicts are resolved by documented rules, inland lakes are split by nearest-boundary allocation, and post-2014 delegations are rebuilt from their imadas using the electoral authority's (ISIE) official lists. Then mapshaper simplifies with topology preserved. Read the **[methodology](docs/methodology.md)**. ## 🧭 One frame, real kilometres Every SVG uses the same `viewBox="0 0 406 838"` in **WGS 84 / UTM zone 32N** with **1 unit = 1 km**. Files of different partitions overlay perfectly, distances can be read straight off the map, and the dependency-free [`project()`](src/projection.js) helper (tested to < 1 mm against PROJ) places any longitude/latitude. See **[projection & coordinates](docs/projection.md)**. ## 🛠️ Build from source ```bash npm install npm run build # dist/ from data/ in ~30 s npm test # 160+ checks: counts, ids, nesting, areas, populations, XML validity, sizes, projection # refresh from the latest OpenStreetMap data (Python 3.10+) pip install -r scripts/extract/requirements.txt npm run fetch && npm run extract && npm run build ``` The pipeline: **pyosmium + Shapely** (extraction and topology) → **mapshaper** (dissolve, projection, simplification) → a custom SVG writer (labels with polylabel, map colouring, accessible markup). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#project-layout). ## 🗺️ Roadmap - [x] 6 nested partitions, 5 levels of detail, 8 modes - [x] All 279 delegations of the 2024 nomenclature - [x] GeoJSON / TopoJSON / CSV, projection helper, live explorer - [ ] Municipalities (*baladiyat*) as a separate, non-nested partition - [ ] Optional water layer: lagoons, sebkhas, chotts and dams - [ ] Cities and capitals as point layers - [ ] Tamazight (Tifinagh) and English-transliteration label modes - [ ] Published npm package and versioned release ZIPs Ideas and votes are welcome in the [issues](https://github.com/Alaa-Taieb/map-tunisia/issues). ## 🤝 Contributing Spotted a wrong border, name or code? **[Report a data error](https://github.com/Alaa-Taieb/map-tunisia/issues/new?template=data-error.yml)**. It's the most valuable contribution you can make.
